Wong Ming Yang (王明揚)
宁波                                      D.S. McKeown
成都路捕房      1937年12月30日              高级探员 Kao Yen Ken

    我叫王明揚，24岁，宁波人，已婚。我是中国保险公司推销员，该公司位于北京路与江西路转角的中国银行大楼，我居住在曼达雷路20号久富里。我是外商华员联益会会员，该会原址位于汉口路115号，现址位于爱多亚路与河南路转角的浦东银行大楼（二楼），该会是职业界救国会的一部分。我自动成为救国会会员，该会在华军撤退后解散。
    1937年11月底，蒙脱班路（Rue Montauban）法亚保险公司买办、兼外商华员联益会组织部职员的杨延修（Yang Yien Siu），请我协助他在难民中开展救国工作。他属于职业界救国会，其秘密办公地点的地址我不知晓。虽然我是该组织成员，但我仅接受杨的命令。难民工作是其职业界救国会计划的一部分。我的主要工作是递送物品，包括旗帜和卡片。虽然有多人在该组织工作，但我只认识以下人员：-
1. 杨延修
2. 杨元康（在押）。

page_data.en:
- 2 -

3. Wong Moo Vung (王慕文), unemployed, living in Room 218,
Bubbling Well Building, Bubbling Well Road, who deals
with the printing of the cards and other matters.
4. Chun nung (黎虹), a school teacher by profession,
whereabouts unknown.
I understand that all the other work is detailed to persons
by Yang Yien Siu. Room 218 was formerly occupied by the
Native Bank Employees Lien Nyi Society and vacated about three
days ago. From the commencement of December up to now, I and
the other members used the room as a communication address.
Through the arrangements made by Wong Moo Vung, a quantity of
flags, cards, printed matter as well as a mimeograph were
brought to the room about two or three days ago.
With regard to the "Refugee Camp Workers' Lien Nyi Society,"
I understand that before the withdrawal of Chinese troops from
Shanghai, the Vocational Circles National Salvation Association
convened meetings of a number of workers of refugee camps
from time to time, and thus they formed an organization known
as the "Refugee Camp Workers' Lien Nyi Society." I also
know that Chun Hung is the member of the Vocational Circles
National Salvation Association who communicates with the
Refugee Camp Workers Lien Nyi Society.
At about 2.30 p.m. December 30, I arrived at the room
in the Bubbling Well Building, Bubbling Well Road, with a view
to discussing with Wong Moo Vung the distribution of the flags,
cards and a periodical entitled "Friends of Refugees" to
various refugee camps before the New Year. While I was waiting
for him, the Police came and took me to Chengtu Road Station.
page_data.zh:
- 2 -

3. 王慕文（Wong Moo Vung），无业，居住在南京路沙逊大厦218室，负责印制卡片及其他事务。
4. 黎虹（Chun nung），职业为教师，下落不明。
据我所知，所有其他工作均由杨延修分配给相关人员。218室原由钱业同业职工联益会占用，约三天前搬空。从12月初至今，我和其他成员使用该房间作为通讯地址。通过王慕文的安排，大约两三天前，一批旗帜、卡片、印刷品以及一台油印机被带入该房间。
关于“难民收容所职员联益会”，据我了解，在华军撤出上海之前，职业界救国会不时召集部分难民收容所工作人员开会，从而组建了一个名为“难民收容所职员联益会”的组织。我也知道春鸿（Chun Hung）是职业界救国会中与难民收容所职员联益会联络的成员。
12月30日下午2点30分左右，我到达南京路沙逊大厦的房间，打算与王慕文讨论在新年前向各难民收容所分发旗帜、卡片和名为《难民之友》的期刊事宜。当我在等他时，警察到来并将我带至成都路捕房。

page_data.en:
- 3 -

All the addresses of various refugee camps as well as the flags,
cards, and the periodical are in the charge of Wong Moo Vung.
It was intended that a parcel be delivered to Jen Chi Tang
Benevolent Society, 35 Yunnan Road, for distribution among its
refugee camps and distribution to other camps be dealt with by me
and my assistant Yang Yuan Kong (in custody).

I do not know the present secret organization of the
Vocational Circles National Salvation Association. I only
know Yang Yien Siu under whom I work in the Association.

As to Yang Yuan Kong, I met him at the corner of Bubbling
Well and Yates Roads at about 10 a.m. December 30 and as he
is my friend and also a member of the Vocational Circles
National Salvation Association, I asked him to attend Room 218
Bubbling Well Building, Bubbling Well Road and help to deliver
parcels.
page_data.zh:
- 3 -

各难民收容所的所有地址以及旗帜、卡片和期刊均由王慕文保管。
原计划将一个包裹送至云南路35号仁济堂善会，由其在其管理的难民收容所中分发，而其他收容所的分发工作则由我和我的助手杨元康（在押）处理。

我不知道职业界救国会目前的秘密组织架构。我只知道在该会中我受杨延修领导。

至于杨元康，我于12月30日上午10点左右在南京路与 Yates Road（音译：耶茨路）转角遇见他，因他是我的朋友，也是职业界救国会成员，我便请他前往南京路沙逊大厦218室，协助递送包裹。

page_data.en:
Yang Yuan Kong (楊元康)
Ningpo                                      D.S. McKeown
Chengtu Rd. Stn.    30/12/37                D.S.I. Kao Yen Ken

My name is Yang Yuan Kong, aged 24, native of Ningpo,
and a shroff in the employ of the Foch Rubber Co., 490
Avenue Foch. I reside on the premises of the firm.
At about 10 a.m. December 30, at the corner of Bubbling
Well and Yates Roads, I met Wong Ming Yang (王明揚), now in
custody, a salesman in the employ of the China Insurance Co.,
Avenue Joffre (formerly situated on Szechuen Road), who was
a fellow member of the Vocational Circles National Salvation
Association prior to the withdrawal of Chinese troops from
Shanghai. He told me that as the situation was very tense,
workers for the national salvation movement were few and that
it was proposed that national flags should be hoisted in
refugee camps in celebration of the New Year Festival. He did
not tell me who proposed the movement. He requested me to
call at his "place," Room 218 Bubbling Well Building, Bubbling
Well Road, off Carter Road, at 2 p.m. and take a bundle of
national flags to the Jen Chi Tang Benevolent Society, 35
Yunnan Road, which takes charge of a part of local refugee
camps. At 2.30 p.m. I arrived at the room where I met Wong
and was given a bundle of flags with instructions to take it
to the Refugee Reception Section of the Jen Chi Tang (i.e.
the Disaster Relief Federation of Shanghai Benevolent Societies).
I have not engaged in any "national salvation" activities
since the withdrawal of the Chinese troops, when all local
national salvation associations were dissolved. I learned
recently from my friends that these associations had lately
endeavoured to resume operations secretly and were maintaining
page_data.zh:
杨元康 (楊元康)
宁波                                      D.S. McKeown
成都路捕房    1937年12月30日                高级探员 Kao Yen Ken

我叫杨元康，24岁，宁波人，受雇于福煦路490号福昌橡胶公司，担任出纳员。我居住在公司 premises（音译：处所/宿舍）。
12月30日上午10点左右，在南京路与 Yates Road（音译：耶茨路）转角，我遇见了目前在押的王明揚（Wong Ming Yang），他是中国保险公司（原位于四川路，现位于霞飞路）的推销员，在华军撤出上海前，我们是职业界救国会的同事。他告诉我，由于局势非常紧张，救国运动工作人员很少，提议在难民收容所悬挂国旗以庆祝新年。他没有告诉我是谁提出了这项运动。他要求我下午2点去他的“地方”，即卡特路（Carter Road）旁南京路沙逊大厦218室，取一捆国旗送往云南路35号仁济堂善会，该会负责管理部分本地难民收容所。下午2点30分，我到达该房间，见到王某，并收到一捆旗帜，指示我将其送往仁济堂（即上海慈善团体联合救灾会）的难民接待部。
自从华军撤退、本地所有救国会解散以来，我没有参与任何“救国”活动。我最近从朋友处得知，这些协会最近试图秘密恢复运作，并维持着

page_data.en:
- 2 -
offices in private houses. Meanwhile these organizations are
in close touch with each other. The workers of these bodies
are few. The room in the Bubbling Well Building is temporarily
occupied for national salvation activities in refugee camps.
It is the first time that I visited the room on the afternoon
of December 30. I do not know the names of the promoters of
the national salvation movement and I can give no information
concerning their meeting places.

(Signed) : Yang Yuan Kong.
page_data.zh:
- 2 -
在私人住宅中的办事处。同时，这些组织之间保持密切联系。这些机构的工作人员很少。沙逊大厦的房间是临时占用，用于难民收容所的救国活动。这是我第一次在12月30日下午访问该房间。我不知道救国运动发起人的姓名，也无法提供有关他们集会地点的信息。

（签名）：杨元康。

page_data.en:
Tseu Zung Teh (周成德)
Ningpo                                      D.S. McKeown
Chengtu Rd Stn          30/12/37            Clerk Loh Wei Kong

My name is Tseu Zung Teh, age 18, native of Ningpo,
single and unemployed.
Following the outbreak of the local Sino-Japanese
hostilities, I left for Ningpo and remained at my native
place until December 4 when I returned here by steamer, with
a view to seeking employment. After returning, I stayed in
the premises of the Kuh Sung Company, a cotton exchange
agency, No. 1 Szechuen Road, now closed, where I was formerly
employed as a telephone operator. (It was a Chinese concern,
but the manager was Japanese). Four days later I left this
place and went to reside with my friend Woo Dah-ming (〔此处转录不清〕),
room 15, 110 Avenue Edward VII. Woo formerly was also
employed by the Kuh Sung Company as an accountant.
During the afternoon of December 12, at about
2 p.m., I went to see Zee Tseng-yue (〔此处转录不清〕), a friend
of mine, and an apprentice of the Van Foong (〔此处转录不清〕) Cereal
Hong, No. 1 Szechuen Road, at his place of employment, and
requested him to seek employment for me. He promised to
consider my request. On the forenoon of December 13, Zee
Tseng-yue came to see me at Room 15, 110 Avenue Edward VII,
and told me to see one named Zung (程), at 10 Doong Yih
Li, Bubbling Well Road. I accordingly went there on
the afternoon of the same day, when Zung asked me to take
care of old cotton clothes contributed by the public for
the relief of refugees, and promised me a monthly subsidy
of $6.00. I went to Room 218, Bubbling Well Apartments
page_data.zh:
周成德 (Tseu Zung Teh)
宁波                                      D.S. McKeown
成都路捕房          1937年12月30日            职员 罗伟公 (Loh Wei Kong)

本人周成德，现年18岁，籍贯宁波，未婚，无业。
自本地中日战事爆发后，我前往宁波，并留在原籍直至12月4日，随后乘轮船返回此地，以期寻找工作。回来后，我住在四川路1号已歇业的“谷松公司”（Kuh Sung Company，一家棉花交易所代理行）的 premises 内，我以前受雇于该公司担任电话接线员。（这是一家华商企业，但经理是日本人）。四天后我离开该处，去与我的朋友吴达明 (Woo Dah-ming)〔此处转录不清〕同住，地址为爱德华七世路110号15室。吴以前也受雇于谷松公司担任会计。
12月12日下午约2时，我去看望我的朋友、四川路1号“万丰” (Van Foong)〔此处转录不清〕粮行的学徒曾悦 (Zee Tseng-yue)〔此处转录不清〕，在他工作的地方请求他为我谋职。他答应考虑我的请求。12月13日上午，曾悦来到爱德华七世路110号15室看我，并叫我去静安寺路东义里10号见一位姓程 (Zung) 的人。我于是于当天下午前往，程叫我负责照料公众捐赠用于救济难民的旧棉衣，并答应每月给我6元津贴。我遵照程的指示，于12月15日前往静安寺公寓

page_data.en:
- 2 -

on December 15, by order of Zung, where I met Wong Mou-wen
(王慕文), who claimed to be a member of the Refugee Camp
Workers' Lien Nyi Society. Zung told me to receive some
80 old cotton padded vests sent by a certain person, and
instructed me to distribute them to all persons who visited
the room and applied for them. Some 70 of these vests were
distributed, while the remainder are still being kept in the
room.

Before December 15, I was living with Woo Dah-ming
in Room 15, 110 Avenue Edward VII, and Zee Tseng-yue, who
had resigned from the Van Foong Cereal Hong, also came to
stay with us on December 14. Due to the fact that Woo
Dah-ming objected to us living in his room, Zee Tseng-yue
and I removed to the room above the Keng Sing Li (敬辛里),
Weihaiwei Road, where we stayed until December 27, when I
removed to Room 218, Bubbling Well Apartments, Bubbling Well
Road, on the morning, and Zee Tseng-yue also removed to this
address during the afternoon of the same day. Zee, however,
came to occupy the room on December 28.

On December 28, Wong Mou-wen showed me some 3,000
copies of the Chinese National Flag printed on paper, and
300 new year greeting cards kept in the room, and told me
to distribute them to all persons who called at the room
and applied for them. On the forenoon of December 29,
three Chinese (all about thirty years of age), claiming
to be members of refugee camps, came to the room, and each
produced a chit and asked for the issue of the flags and
page_data.zh:
- 2 -

218室，在那里我遇到了王慕文 (Wong Mou-wen)，他自称是难民收容所工作人员联谊会的成员。程叫我接收某人所送来的约80件旧棉背心，并指示我将它们分发给所有来到该房间申请的人。其中约70件背心已分发出去，其余的仍存放在房间内。

在12月15日之前，我与吴达明同住在爱德华七世路110号15室，而从万丰粮行辞职的曾悦也于12月14日来与我们同住。由于吴达明反对我们住在他的房间里，曾悦和我搬到了威海卫路敬辛里 (Keng Sing Li) 楼上的房间，我们住到12月27日，当天上午我搬到了静安寺路静安寺公寓218室，曾悦也于同日下午搬到了这个地址。不过，曾悦是在12月28日才入住该房间的。

12月28日，王慕文给我看了房间里存放的约3,000份印在纸上的中国国旗和300张新年贺卡，并叫我把它们分发给所有来到房间申请的人。12月29日上午，三名中国人（年龄均在三十岁左右）来到房间，自称是难民收容所的成员，每人出示了一张纸条，要求领取旗帜和

page_data.en:
- 3 -

new year greeting cards. I accordingly distributed to
each of them some 100 copies of the paper flag. Since
then no one has visited the room.
I have no knowledge regarding the organization
of the Refugee Camp Workers' Lien-Nyi Society.

Signed : Tseu Zung Teh.
page_data.zh:
- 3 -

新年贺卡。于是我分发给每人约100份纸质国旗。此后便无人再来过该房间。
我对难民收容所工作人员联谊会的组织情况一无所知。

签名：周成德。

page_data.en:
Zee Tseng Yue 徐振裕 )
Ningpo                                      D.S. Mckeown
Cehngtu Rd. Stn.      30/12/37              Clerk Liao Chung Chien

My name is Zee Tseng Yue, aged 21, native of Ningpo,
single. I am unemployed, formerly working as a clerk in
the Van Foong 萬丰 ) Cereal Hong, 120 Avenue Edward VII, and
leaving the employment on December 14 1937 owing to trade
depression. I reside in Room 218, Bubbling Well Apartments,
Bubbling Well Road to which address I removed on December 27.
I joined the Vocational Circles National Salvation
Association in August 1937 when it was situated in the Sing
Kwan Primary School, Chungking Road. I was also a member of
the Cereal Hong Employees Lien Nyi Club, Min Kuo Road, which
was dissolved after the withdrawal of the Chinese forces
from Shanghai.
Although I was a member of the Vocational Circles
National Salvation Association I did not take part in its
activities except soliciting funds from friends and relatives
on its behalf on two occasions in September and October,
1937, respectively.
My friend Tseu Zung Teh 周成德 ) was formerly employed
by Kuh Sung Co., No.1 Szechuen Rd., and is at present unemployed.
On December 13, 1937, I introduced him to Mr. Zung Tsing 程俊 )
who is a clerk in the Customs Employees Club, Dong Yih Li,
Bubbling Well Road, and a member of the Shanghai Vocational
Circles National Salvation Association. On the instructions
of Zung Tsing, Tseu Zung Teh on 15/12/37 went to Room 218
Bubbling Apartments, Bubbling Well Road, and collected at that
addressed funds raised by members of the Association.
On December 14, 1937, when I was discharged by the Van
page_data.zh:
徐振裕 (Zee Tseng Yue)
宁波                                      D.S. Mckeown
成都路捕房          1937年12月30日              职员 廖仲坚 (Liao Chung Chien)

本人徐振裕，现年21岁，籍贯宁波，未婚。我目前无业，此前在爱德华七世路120号万丰 (Van Foong) 粮行担任职员，因市面萧条于1937年12月14日离职。我现居住在静安寺路静安寺公寓218室，我是于12月27日搬至此处的。
1937年8月，当职业界救国会设在重庆路新关小学时，我加入了该会。我也是民国路粮行职工联谊会的成员，该会在华军撤离上海后解散。
虽然我是职业界救国会的成员，但我并未参与其活动，除了在1937年9月和10月分别两次代表该会向亲友募捐外。
我的朋友周成德 (Tseu Zung Teh) 以前受雇于四川路1号的谷松公司，目前失业。
1937年12月13日，我将他介绍给程俊 (Zung Tsing) 先生，程是静安寺路东义里海关职工俱乐部的职员，也是上海职业界救国会的成员。根据程俊的指示，周成德于1937年12月15日前往静安寺路静安寺公寓218室，并在该地址收取了该会会员募集的资金。
1937年12月14日，当我被万

page_data.en:
- 2 -

Foong Cereal Hong, I went to live with one Wu Tah Ming (鄔達明)
and Tseu Zung Teh (周成德) both of whom are my friends, at
No. 110 Avenue Edward VII. I had at the time a sum of $70.00
which I had saved from my monthly wages. I have spent about
$14.00 for food and locomotion during the past fifteen days
and have at present $56.00 in hand.

While Tseu Zung Teh attended the Bubbling Well Apartments
daily, I went out to call on my friends and relatives with a
view to securing employment. At the same time I also approached
one Waung Tse Tsang (汪子章), an employee of the Yung Dah
Cereal Hong, Rue Montauban, with the object of organizing a
food and fuel supply agency.

On December 16, Tseu and Wu had a quarrel over money and
consequently I and Tseu removed to a room above the Keng Sing
Li (耕莘里) Alleyway, Weihaiwei Road, where we resided up
to December 27 when we went to reside in Room 218 Bubbling Well
Apartments.

Room No. 218 was also shared by two other persons, one
named Wong Moo Vung (王慕文), while the name of the other
I do not know. They had resided in the room before we removed
there. I knew that Wong Moo Vung was employed in a certain
refugee camp. I had not had much conversation with him because
I used to go out during the day to see my friends and relatives.

I am not so much interested in the national salvation
movement as my employment and I do not know what activities
the Vocational Circles National Salvation Association is
undertaking.

(Signed) Zee Tseng Yue.
page_data.zh:
- 2 -

丰粮行解雇时，我去与我的朋友吴达明 (Wu Tah Ming) 和周成德 (Tseu Zung Teh) 同住，地址为爱德华七世路110号。当时我有从月薪中积攒下来的70元。在过去十五天里，我花费了约14元用于食物和交通，目前手头尚有56元。

当周成德每天去静安寺公寓时，我外出拜访亲友以谋求职业。同时，我还接触了蒙托邦路 (Rue Montauban) 永大粮行的职员汪子章 (Waung Tse Tsang)，目的是组织一个粮食和燃料供应机构。

12月16日，周和吴因金钱问题发生争吵，因此我和周搬到了威海卫路耕莘里 (Keng Sing Li) 弄堂楼上的一个房间，我们一直住到12月27日，随后搬入静安寺公寓218室。

218室还由另外两人合住，一人名叫王慕文 (Wong Moo Vung)，另一人的姓名我不知道。在我们搬去之前，他们就已经住在这个房间里。我知道王慕文在某个难民收容所工作。我与他交谈不多，因为我白天常外出拜访亲友。

比起救国运动，我更关心我的就业问题，我不知道职业界救国会正在进行什么活动。

(签名) 徐振裕。

page_data.en:
Wong Yih (王乙) alias Wong Ai Yue (王衡遠)
Shing Hwa (兴化), Kiangsu D.S. McKeown.
Chengtu Rd. Stn. 30/12/37 Clerk Zung.

My name is Wong Yih alias Wong Ai Yue. I am 24 years
of age, a native of Shing Hwa ( ), Kiangsu, single, and
unemployed at present. I am living at the Refugee
Camp Workers' Lien Nyi Society, Room 218 Bubbling Well
Apartments, Bubbling Well Road.

Prior to the outbreak of the Sino-Japanese hostilities,
I was employed in the King Nyi (景藝) Flower Shop, 400
Tiendong Road, and shortly after the outbreak of the
hostilities, I went to my native place, Shing Hwa, Kiangsu,
as the shop suspended business.

On December 24, I returned to Shanghai as I believed
that the shop would reopen in the near future. Upon
arrival I went to live with my friend named Wong Mou-vung
(王慕文), at the Refugee Camp Workers' Lien Nyi Society,
Room 218 Bubbling Well Apartments, Bubbling Well Road.

I met Wong Mou-vung for the first time about three
monghts ago, when I was still in Shanghai, in the club of
bank and native bank employees, then situated in Room 218
Bubbling Well Apartments, through the introduction of one
Yuan Ching Wei (袁青衛) who was formerly one of my
National
fellow workers in the Chinese Goods Emporium,
Continental Banking Building, Nanking Road, and whose
present whereabouts I do not know.

As far as I know, Wong Mou-vung is an officer of the
Refugee Camp Workers' Lien Nyi Society, and undertakes the
education of refugees. Apart from living with him as I
am unable to find some other place, I have no connections
with Wong Mou-vung. I am not engaged in any national
page_data.zh:
王乙 (Wong Yih)，又名王衡远 (Wong Ai Yue)
江苏兴化 (Shing Hwa)                          D.S. McKeown.
成都路捕房 1937年12月30日 职员 程 (Zung).

本人王乙，又名王衡远。现年24岁，籍贯江苏兴化 ( )，未婚，目前无业。我居住在静安寺路静安寺公寓218室的难民收容所工作人员联谊会。

在中日战事爆发前，我受雇于提篮桥路400号的景艺 (King Nyi) 花店，战事爆发后不久，因店铺停业，我回到了原籍江苏兴化。

12月24日，我认为该店不久将重新开业，便返回上海。抵达后，我去与我的朋友王慕文 (Wong Mou-vung) 同住，地址为静安寺路静安寺公寓218室的难民收容所工作人员联谊会。

我大约在三个月前第一次见到王慕文，当时我还在上海，通过袁青卫 (Yuan Ching Wei) 的介绍，在位于静安寺公寓218室的银行及钱庄职员俱乐部认识了他。袁青卫以前是我在南京路大陆银行大楼中国商品陈列馆的同事，我目前不知道他的下落。

据我所知，王慕文是难民收容所工作人员联谊会的干事，负责难民的教育工作。除了因为找不到其他地方而与他同住外，我与王慕文没有任何其他联系。我没有参与任何救国

page_data.en:
- 2 -

salvation work at present.
    I admit I was a member of the Shanghai Vocational
Circles Association to Save the Nation prior to my departure
for my native place. I was employed in the office of the
Association in the Sing Kwai Primary School, Park Road, as
a general duty clerk, and I did not undertake any propaganda
work. I remained there for about twenty days and then
the association was closed by the Police. After this, I
went to my native place and returned here only recently.

            (Signed) Wong Yih.
page_data.zh:
- 2 -

工作。
    我承认，在离开前往原籍之前，我是上海职业界救国会的成员。我在派克路新关小学的该会办事处担任庶务职员，并未从事任何宣传工作。我在那里待了大约二十天，随后该会被警方关闭。此后，我回到了原籍，直到最近才返回这里。

            (签名) 王乙。

page_data.en:
Loo Chi Yuan (羅志元)
Shanghai                                      D.S. McKeown
Chengtu Rd Stn            30/12/37            Clerk Zung Zoong-oen

My name is Loo Chi Yuan.    I am nineteen years
of age, a native of Shanghai, unmarried.    I have been
working as an apprentice in the Tsing Yuan Cereal Hong
(乾源豆麥行), upper portion of the Sing Kee Shipping Hong
(新記輪船行), Rue du Consulat, French Concession, for
about three years, and I am living there.
    About two or three days ago, my friend Zee Tseng-
yue (徐增裕), ex-employee of the Van Foong Cereal Hong,
called on me at my place of employment.    He informed me
that he was unemployed and asked me to visit him at Room
218, Bubbling Well Apartments, Bubbling Well Road, when-
ever I had time, explaining that he desired to have a
conversation with me.    At about 6 p.m., December 30,
I left my place of employment for the Bubbling Well
Apartments.    Unexpectedly I was arrested by the Police
upon entering Room 218 where I expected to meet my friend.
I do not know the reason of my arrest, and I have no
knowledge of the business that my friend was doing.

                                Signed :    Loo Chi Yuan
page_data.zh:
罗志元 (Loo Chi Yuan)
上海                                      D.S. McKeown
成都路捕房            1937年12月30日            职员 程宗恩 (Zung Zoong-oen)

本人罗志元。现年十九岁，籍贯上海，未婚。我在法租界领事馆路新记轮船行 (Sing Kee Shipping Hong) 上层的乾源豆麦行 (Tsing Yuan Cereal Hong) 当学徒已有约三年时间，并居住在那里。
大约两三天前，我的朋友、前万丰粮行职员徐增裕 (Zee Tseng-yue) 到我工作的地方来访。他告诉我他失业了，并请我有空时去静安寺路静安寺公寓218室看他，解释说他想与我谈谈。12月30日下午6点左右，我离开工作地点前往静安寺公寓。没想到在进入218室时，我被警察逮捕，我原本指望在那里见到我的朋友。我不知道被捕的原因，也不了解我朋友正在做的事情。

                                签名：    罗志元

page_data.en:
Ling Lien Fang (凌联芳)
Shanghai                                      D.S. McKeown
Chengtu Rd Stn          30/12/37              D.S.I. Kao Yen-ken

My name is Ling Lien-fang, aged 21, native of
Shanghai and single. I am a partner of the Woo Sung
(和生) Flour Shop, 41 Wuting Road. I am living in
house 65 Chao Ka Jao off Hart Road.

I am not a member of the Vocational Circles
National Salvation Association nor of the Refugee Camp
Workers' Lien Nyi Society.

At 5 p.m., December 29, Tseu Zung-teh (周成德),
a friend of mine, who worked with me as a clerk in the
Kuh Sung Firm, a Japanese cotton yarn exchange agency,
No.1 Szechuen Road, before the local hostilities, came
to the Woo Sung Flour Shop, 41 Wuting Road and asked me
to lend him $10 as capital to enter the coal business.
At that time he told me that he lived in Room 218,
Bubbling Well Apartments, Bubbling Well Road and worked
on behalf of refugees. As to the loan, I promised to
try to get some money for him, and he stated that he
would call on me again at 6 p.m. December 30. At this
hour, however, he failed to turn up. As I could not
get any money for him, I decided to give him a reply.
So with my friend Oo Ching-vung (鄔錦文), I went to
Room 218, Bubbling Well Apartments, where we were taken
by detectives to Chengtu Road Station.

Signed : Ling Lien-fang.
page_data.zh:
凌联芳 (Ling Lien Fang)
上海                                      D.S. McKeown
成都路捕房          1937年12月30日              副督察长 高延根 (Kao Yen-ken)

本人凌联芳，现年21岁，籍贯上海，未婚。我是五通路41号和生 (Woo Sung) 面粉店的合伙人。我居住在赫德路 (Hart Road) 旁的曹家宅65号。

我不是职业界救国会的成员，也不是难民收容所工作人员联谊会的成员。

12月29日下午5时，我的朋友周成德 (Tseu Zung-teh) 来到五通路41号的和生面粉店。战事爆发前，他曾在四川路1号的日本棉花交易所代理行谷松 firm 与我一同担任职员。他向我借款10元作为经营煤炭生意的本金。当时他告诉我，他住在静安寺路静安寺公寓218室，并为难民工作。关于借款，我答应尽力为他筹款，他说他将于12月30日下午6时再次来访。然而，届时他并未出现。由于我无法为他筹到款项，我决定给他一个答复。于是，我与我的朋友邬锦文 (Oo Ching-vung) 一同前往静安寺公寓218室，在那里我们被侦探带往成都路捕房。

签名：凌联芳。

page_data.en:
Li Nyih-jing (李業勤)
Ningpo                                      D.S. Pitts
Chengtu Rd Stn             30/12/37         D.S.I. Kao Yen-ken

My name is Li Nyih-jing, age 21, a native of Ningpo
and single. I am unemployed but was formerly a clerk in the
Kuh Sung Firm, a Japanese cotton yarn exchange agency, No.1
Szechuen Road. I am at present living in Room 218, Bubbling
Well Apartments, Bubbling Well Road.

Following the outbreak of the local hostilities, I
went to Hangchow to take refuge and later to my native place
at Ningpo. On December 11, I returned to Shanghai with a view
to withdrawing my deposits from the Bank of China and the Yien
Nyih Bank. I withdrew $92.46, and remitted $80 to my uncle in
Ningpo, retaining the remainder in order to open a stall in
Shanghai so as to earn a living. About December 17, I opened
a macaroni stall on Wuting Road in front of the Wu Sung Flour
Shop, near Carter Road. On December 24, as I had lost most
of my money, I decided to close the stall. At that time I
lived in the Woo Sung Flour Shop. During my stay there, one
of my friends named Tseu Zung-teh called on me often. On
December 24, as the room in the flour shop was small, Tseu
advised me to stay with him in Room 218, Bubbling Well Apart-
ments, Bubbling Well Road, which, he told me, was an office
for the relief of refugees. There I have stayed up to the
present.

As there were many persons present in the room during
the day, I remained there only during the night.

I am not a member of the Vocational Circles National
Salvation Association nor of the Refugee Camp Workers' Lien Nyi
Society.
page_data.zh:
李業勤 (Li Nyih-jing)
宁波                                      D.S. Pitts
成都路捕房             1937年12月30日         高级巡长 高恩根 (Kao Yen-ken)

本人李業勤，现年21岁，宁波人，未婚。目前无业，此前曾在四川路1号日本棉纱交易所代理机构“古松洋行”（Kuh Sung Firm）担任职员。现居住在静安寺路（Bubbling Well Road）静安公寓（Bubbling Well Apartments）218室。

本地战事爆发后，我先去杭州避难，随后回到家乡宁波。12月11日，我返回上海，打算从中国银行和业益银行（Yien Nyih Bank）提取存款。我提取了92.46元，汇款80元给在宁波的叔叔，余款留作在上海开设摊位以谋生之用。约在12月17日，我在吴淞面粉店（Wu Sung Flour Shop）前的武定路（Wuting Road）、靠近卡特路（Carter Road）处开设了一个通心粉摊位。12月24日，由于大部分资金已亏损，我决定关闭摊位。当时我住在吴淞面粉店。在此期间，我的一位名叫朱宗德（Tseu Zung-teh）的朋友经常来看望我。12月24日，因面粉店的房间狭小，朱建议我与他同住在静安寺路静安公寓218室，他告诉我那里是一个难民救济办公室。我一直住在那里至今。

由于白天房间里人多，我只在夜间居住于此。

我不是职业界救国会成员，也不是难民营工作人员联益社（Lien Nyi Society）成员。

page_data.en:
- 2 -

I know nothing of Tseu Zung-teh's activities or
private life beyond the fact that prior to the trouble
in Shanghai he worked in the same concern at 1 Szechuen
Road as I did.

Signed : Li Nyih-jing.
page_data.zh:
- 2 -

除了知道朱宗德在上海事变前与我同在四川路1号的同一机构工作外，我对他的活动或私生活一无所知。

签名：李業勤。

page_data.en:
Oo Ching Wen (鄔錦文)
Ningpo                                      D.S. Pitta
Chengtu Rd Stn          30/12/37            Clerk Zung.

My name is Oo Ching Wen. I am 19 years of age,
a native of Ningpo, single, and unemployed at present. I
am living at No. 1017 Sinza Road.
Prior to the outbreak of the Sino-Japanese
hostilities, I was employed as an inspector of the Shanghai
Office of the Joss Paper Tax Bureau, No. 230 Dah Mou Deu,
Nantao, but was deprived of employment owing to the
hostilities. As I had nothing to do, I often visited my
old friend Ling Lien Fang (凌連芳), co-proprietor of the
Woo Sung (和生) Macaroni Shop, at No. 25 Wuting Road.
Ling and I were fellow workers in the Shanghai Cotton
Exchange, Avenue Edward VII, about three years ago.
At 8 p.m. December 30, I again called upon Ling
Lien Fang at No. 25 Wuting Road. He told me that he was
going to visit Tseu Zung Teh (in custody) at Room 218,
Bubbling Well Road, to ask for a loan from him. Tseu is
also a friend of mine, as we three were fellow workers in
the Shanghai Cotton Exchange, Avenue Edward VII. Consequently
Ling asked me to accompany him to Tseu's place and I agreed.
Upon entering Room 218, Bubbling Well Apartments, both of
us were arrested by the Police. I do not know the reason
of our arrest, and have no knowledge of the activities of
the two friends mentioned above.

Signed : Oo Ching Wen;
page_data.zh:
鄔錦文 (Oo Ching Wen)
宁波                                      D.S. Pitta
成都路捕房          1937年12月30日            书记员 Zung。

本人鄔錦文。现年19岁，宁波人，未婚，目前无业。现居住在新闸路（Sinza Road）1017号。
在中日敌对行动爆发之前，我受雇于南市大码头（Dah Mou Deu）230号冥纸税局（Joss Paper Tax Bureau）上海办事处，担任稽查员，但因战事而失业。由于无事可做，我经常拜访我的老朋友凌連芳（Ling Lien Fang），他是武定路25号和生（Woo Sung）通心粉店的共同经营者。大约三年前，我和凌曾在爱多亚路（Avenue Edward VII）的上海棉花交易所共事。
12月30日晚8点，我再次前往武定路25号拜访凌連芳。他告诉我，他打算去静安寺路静安公寓218室拜访朱宗德（目前在押），向他借钱。朱也是我的朋友，因为我们三人曾在爱多亚路的上海棉花交易所共事。因此，凌邀请我陪同他前往朱的住处，我同意了。进入静安公寓218室后，我们两人均被警察逮捕。我不知道被捕的原因，也不了解上述两位朋友的活动情况。

签名：鄔錦文；

page_data.en:
Loo Wen-lai (盧文來)
Nyi Ping (南坪), Szechuen           D.S. McKeown
Chengtu Rd. Stn.      30/12/37      Clerk Loh Wei-kong.

My name is Loo Wen-lai, age 26, native of Nyi Ping,
Szechuen, single, residing in the Yuin Tung (運通) Steamship
Company, North Soochow Road. My father died when I
was twelve years of age. When I was six years old, I
commenced studying Chinese under a tutor. I went to the
High Primary Schook established by the Hsien Government
of my native place, at the age of 13. After two years,
I continued my study in the Junior Middle School, also
established by the Hsien Government at my native place.
Owing to the fact that my family was poor, I went to the
Southern Szechuen Academy at Loochow (瀘州), Szechuen,
where the tution was free. I graduated from that school
at the age of 21, and then became a teacher of the Zoong
Yee Primary School (崇義小學) at Loochow. I held this
position for half a year, after which I returned to my
native place with a view to seeking better employment,
but failed. I remained idle at hom for about ten months,
until May, 1933, when I left for Chengtu, with a view to
carryong on my study in the Szechuen University, but I
abandoned this decision because I learned that the Ming
Sung Steamship Company was in need of employees. I passed
the examination for my employment, and was despatched in
August, 1933 to the General Office of the Company at
Chungking, at a monthly pay of $8.00. Being dissatisfied,
I resigned after six months, and came to Shanghai in March,
1934 by a steamer of the Ming Sung Company, free of charge
(employees of the Company were entitled free passage).
page_data.zh:
盧文來 (Loo Wen-lai)
四川南坪 (Nyi Ping)           D.S. McKeown
成都路捕房      1937年12月30日      书记员 罗伟公 (Loh Wei-kong)。

本人盧文來，现年26岁，四川南坪人，未婚，居住在苏州北路运通（Yuin Tung）轮船公司。我十二岁时父亲去世。六岁时，我开始跟随塾师学习中文。十三岁时，我就读于家乡县政府设立的高等小学。两年后，我继续在家乡县政府设立的初级中学就读。由于家境贫寒，我前往四川泸州（Loochow）的川南师范学校（Southern Szechuen Academy），那里免收学费。二十一岁时我从该校毕业，随后成为泸州崇义小学（Zoong Yee Primary School）的教师。我担任此职半年，之后返回家乡寻求更好的工作，但未成功。我在家闲居约十个月，直到1933年5月，我前往成都，打算在四川大学继续学业，但当我得知民生轮船公司（Ming Sung Steamship Company）需要雇员时，便放弃了这一决定。我通过了入职考试，并于1933年8月被派往该公司重庆总办事处，月薪8.00元。因不满意，我在六个月后辞职，并于1934年3月乘坐民生公司的轮船免费（公司员工享有免费通行权）来到上海。

page_data.en:
- 2 -

Upon arrival, I resided at the upper kitchen room, 3 Yue
Ching Li, Avenue Foch, the home of my friend, Mr. Tu Tsoo-
yien (杜祝顏), who was an employee of the Chung San
Cultural Institute (中山文化教育館), Avenue Foch.
About twenty days later, in April, I left my friend for
Nanking with a view to studying in the Central Political
Academy. I remained in Nanking for about three months
during which I prepared for examination to join the
academy, and Mr. Tu remitted me $10.00 each month for
my expenses. As I failed in the examination, I returned
to Shanghai in July, and resided with Mr. Tu Tsoo-yien.
Shortly after my return to Shanghai, I participated in the
examination for joining the Mongolian and Thibetan Institute,
Lunghwa. I succeeded in the examination and studied for
two years. I graduated in the summer of 1936, and became
a teacher of the Ming Tse (明志) Primary School, Meichow
Road. I held this position until the outbreak of the local
Sino-Japanese hostilities.
After the commencement of the local conflict, I
served as a teacher for juvenile refugees in the camp
established in the Empire Theatre, French Concession, under
the auspices of the Szechuen Fellow Countrymen's Association.
Shortly before the withdrawal of the Chinese troops
from Shanghai, the refugee camp was closed owing to
financial difficulty, consequently, I was rendered idle.
Regarding the leaflet entitled "General Outline
of Work during the Propaganda Period," which was seized
page_data.zh:
- 2 -

抵达后，我居住在福煦路（Avenue Foch）月庆里3号楼上厨房房间，那是我的朋友杜祝顏（Tu Tsoo-yien）先生的家，他是福煦路中山文化教育馆（Chung San Cultural Institute）的职员。
大约二十天后，即四月，我离开朋友前往南京，打算在中央政治学院学习。我在南京停留了约三个月，期间准备参加学院的入学考试，杜先生每月汇给我10.00元作为生活费。由于考试落榜，我于七月返回上海，与杜祝顏先生同住。
回到上海后不久，我参加了龙华蒙藏学院（Mongolian and Thibetan Institute, Lunghwa）的入学考试。我考试合格并学习了两年。我于1936年夏季毕业，成为梅丘路（Meichow Road）明志（Ming Tse）小学的教师。我一直担任此职，直到本地中日敌对行动爆发。
本地冲突开始后，我在法租界大戏院（Empire Theatre）内由四川同乡会资助建立的难民营中，担任少年难民教师。
在中国军队撤离上海前不久，该难民营因财政困难而关闭，因此我再次失业。
关于被警方从我处查获的题为《宣传期工作大纲》的传单，

page_data.en:
- 3 -

from me by the Police, I have to state that it was issued
to me by one Ling Yih-sing (林一心), with whom I
became acquainted recently through the introduction of
my friend Mr. Liu Vong-yuen (刘望远 ), who is also a
native of Szechuen. I met Ling several times on the streets
after the removal of the hostilities from Shanghai, and
requested him to assist me in seeking employment in refugee
camps, but up to the present, he has not recommended me to
any camp. He, however, told me during one of our meetings
on the street to call upon him at 77 Tsingtao Road. I went
to see Ling at this address on or about December 22 for the
purpose of getting a reply in connection with my request
for his assistance in securing employment in camps, when he
delivered to me the leaflet without instructions.

I have not participated in any activities conducted by
local national salvation associations, except during the
progress of the local hostilities, I solicited contributions
from my fellow provincials towards the fund for the purchase
of comforts for Chinese soldiers. The contribution
soliciting movement was carried out in the name of the Jui
Tse Study Society (求智讀書會 ) formed by members of the
refugee camp including Mr. Liu Vong-yuen and myself, at the
request of the members of the Vocational Circles' National
Salvation Association during their visit at our refugee camp to
console refugees. Approximately $80.00 were raised and
delivered to the Association in question.

I am not a member of the Communist Party, nor a
Kuomintang member.

Signed: Loo Wen-lai.
page_data.zh:
- 3 -

我必须说明，这是林一心（Ling Yih-sing）发给我的，我是通过我的朋友刘望远（Liu Vong-yuen）先生的介绍最近才认识他的，刘先生也是四川人。在上海战事平息后，我在街上遇到过林几次，并请他协助我在难民营中寻找工作，但到目前为止，他并未将我推荐到任何难民营。然而，在一次街头会面中，他让我去青岛路77号找他。大约在12月22日，我去该地址见林，目的是就他协助我在难民营就业的请求得到答复，当时他将传单交给了我，未作任何指示。

除了在当地战事进行期间，我曾向同乡募集捐款用于购买慰问品赠予中国士兵外，我没有参与任何地方救国团体的活动。募捐活动是以“求智讀書會”的名义进行的，该会由包括刘望远先生和我在内的难民营成员组成，应职业界救国会成员在访问我们难民营慰问难民时的要求而成立。共筹集了约80.00元，并交付给该协会。

我不是共产党员，也不是国民党党员。

签名：盧文來。

page_data.en:
King Jing (金瑾)
Anhwei                                D.S. McKeown
Chengtu Rd. Stn.      30/12/37        D.S.I. Kao Yen-ken

    My name is King Jing, female, aged 23, a native
of Anhwei and single.    I am a student of the Great
China University.    Following the outbreak of the local
hostilities, I removed from the school to the residence
of my school mate named Miss Wu Bai-nwa (吴佩華),
54(?) Route Dolrus.    About a month ago, Miss Wu went
to Hankow, and I therefore went to live with a friend
of Miss Wu, named Ho Ying (何英), in the room above ,
the kitchen at 77 Tsingtao Road.
    During my stay in that house, I noticed that a
number of persons visited the kitchen occupied by one
Chu (朱) and that from conversations among themselves
I realized that they were national salvation workers.
I and Ho Ying one day talked about them.    I was of the
opinion that should the police take action against the
occupants of the kitchen, the authorities might suspect
us, I being a student, to be connected with them.
Therefore we agreed that we should claim to be relatives.
                                    we
This is why we claimed to be relatives when/were taken
into the police station.
    Regarding Ling Yih-sing (林一心), Ling was
one of the visitors of Tsu.    I saw Ling about two or
three times.    He wears spectacles, is of medium size,
wears foreign dress, and speaks Szechuen dialect.    I
did not see him bring or take any books.    I observed
him talking with Tsu.
    I do not know to whom the male clothing, etc.,
which was found in my room belongs, but I think it is
the property of a former tenant who has left for Wusieh.
    I am not a member of any national salvation society.

                            Signed: King Jing.
page_data.zh:
金瑾 (King Jing)
安徽                                D.S. McKeown
成都路捕房      1937年12月30日        高级巡长 高恩根 (Kao Yen-ken)

    本人金瑾，女，现年23岁，安徽人，未婚。我是大夏大学的学生。本地战事爆发后，我从学校搬到了我的同学吴佩華（Wu Bai-nwa）小姐的住所，地址是多乐路（Route Dolrus）54号（?）。大约一个月前，吴小姐去了汉口，因此我去与吴小姐的一位朋友何英（Ho Ying）同住，住在青岛路77号厨房楼上的房间。
    在该处居住期间，我注意到有许多人拜访由一名姓朱（Chu）的人占用的厨房，并且从他们的谈话中我意识到他们是救国工作者。有一天，我和何英谈论起他们。我认为，如果警察对厨房的居住者采取行动，当局可能会怀疑身为学生的我与他们有关联。因此，我们商定声称是亲戚关系。
                                    我们
这就是为什么当/我们在被带进警察局时声称是亲戚的原因。
    关于林一心（Ling Yih-sing），林是朱的访客之一。我见过林两三次。他戴眼镜，中等身材，穿西装，说四川方言。我没见他带来或拿走任何书籍。我观察到他在与朱交谈。
    我不知道在我房间里发现的男装等物品属于谁，但我认为那是以前租客的财产，他已前往无锡（Wusieh）。
    我不是任何救国团体的成员。

                            签名：金瑾。

page_data.en:
Ho Ping (何平) alias Ho Ying (何英).
Hankow                                      D.S. McKeown
Chengtu Rd Stn. 3.15a.m. 31.12.37.          D.S.I. Kao Yen-ken.

    My name is Ho Ping alias Ho Ying, aged 26, a native
of Hankow and married.    I am a school teacher by profession,
being a teacher in the Yangtszepoo Social Centre Primary
School, Yangtszepoo Road, prior to the hostilities.    I
am living in 77 Tsingtao Road.
    I am now serving in the Women's Class of the 7th
Ningpo Fellow Countrymen's Association, Myburgh Road, near
Avenue Road.    This class is opened by an "Education
Developing Service Group" (普及教育服务团), which was formed
following the outbreak of hostilities and aimed at national
salvation work.    The Group, with an office at 77 Tsingtao
Road, was declared dissolved when the Chinese troops withdrew
from the Shanghai Area.    It, however, continues to function
secretly at the same address.    At first I was paid $10
per month without lodging, but at present I am paid $6
with free lodging at 77 Tsingtao Road.    I am paid by Ling
Ih-sing (林一心), one of the leading members of the Group.
There are about 40 workers operating in about 20 classes
known as "Children's classes" or "Women's classes."
    Tsu Shih-tung (朱澤東), a male youth of about 20,
is the man watching the place and receiving letters and
messages.
    Ling Ih-sing visits the place, 77 Tsingtao Road, from
time to time.    His whereabouts is not known.
    In the women's class I am teaching, I was instructed
to teach things in connection with the national salvation
before the withdrawal of the Chinese troops, but after the
page_data.zh:
何平 (Ho Ping)，又名何英 (Ho Ying)。
汉口                                      D.S. McKeown
成都路捕房 1937年12月31日凌晨3:15.          高级巡长 高恩根 (Kao Yen-ken)。

    本人何平，又名何英，现年26岁，汉口人，已婚。我的职业是学校教师，战前曾在杨树浦路杨树浦社会中心初级小学任教。现居住在青岛路77号。
    我目前在迈尔西爱路（Myburgh Road，近爱文义路 Avenue Road）附近的宁波同乡会第七分会妇女班服务。该班级由一个“普及教育服务团”开办，该团是在战事爆发后成立的，旨在进行救国工作。该团在青岛路77号设有办事处，在中国军队撤离上海地区时被宣布解散。然而，它仍在同一地址秘密运作。起初我月薪10元，不包住宿，但目前我月薪6元，并在青岛路77号免费住宿。我的薪水由该团的主要成员之一林一心（Ling Ih-sing）支付。大约有40名工作人员在约20个被称为“儿童班”或“妇女班”的班级中工作。
    朱澤東（Tsu Shih-tung），一名约20岁的男青年，是负责看守场所并接收信件和消息的人。
    林一心不时访问青岛路77号这个地方。他的行踪不明。
    在我任教的妇女班中，在中国军队撤离之前，我被指示教授与救国相关的内容，但在

page_data.en:
- 2 -

withdrawal in view of the local tense situation, I
abandoned all political activities and devoted myself
to pure education.
    There was a mimeograph machine on the premises.
I remember that some class teachers made use of it to
print coloured New Year greeting cards, the contents of
which I have not seen nor do I know.
    In celebration of the New Year, I only asked
the students, numbering 30, to contribute towards the
relief of refugees and would like to instruct some students
to dance in refugee camps as entertainment on January 1.
I do not use greeting cards.
    I am not a Communist.

                    (Signed) Ho Ping alias Ho Ying.
page_data.zh:
- 2 -

撤离后，鉴于当地局势紧张，我放弃了所有政治活动，致力于纯粹的教育工作。
    场所内有一台油印机。我记得有些班级老师利用它印制彩色新年贺卡，其内容我未曾看过，也不知晓。
    为了庆祝新年，我只要求30名学生为救济难民捐款，并打算指导一些学生在1月1日到难民营跳舞作为娱乐。我不使用贺卡。
    我不是共产主义者。

                    （签名）何平，又名何英。

page_data.en:
TRANSLATION

January 14, 1938.

To the Chief of the Special Branch,
Shanghai Municipal Police.

Dear Sir,

On December 30, 1937, Mr. Wong Ai Yuan (alias Wong
Ih), ex-employee of the Chin Yee Flower Shop (Tiendong
Road), of which I was the manager, was arrested and
detained by your Branch owing to certain suspicions.
As he is known to me as a law-abiding subject at
ordinary times, I am willing to act as his guarantor
and request you to release him. After his release
I will arrange for his return to his native place
immediately.

With thanks in advance.

I am, Sir,
Yours respectfully,

(Signed and chopped) Yang Sheu Zung.

Address:
Purchasing Department,
Commercial Press,
Honan Road, Shanghai.
page_data.zh:
译文

1938年1月14日。

致上海公共租界工部局警务处特别部主任。

敬启者：

1937年12月30日，我曾担任经理的天通庵路（Tiendong Road）金义花店（Chin Yee Flower Shop）前雇员黄爱元先生（别名黄毅，Wong Ih），因涉嫌被贵处逮捕并拘留。鉴于他平日为我所知的守法良民，我愿作其担保人，恳请予以释放。获释后，我将安排其立即返回原籍。

先此致谢。

此致
敬礼

（签名并盖章）杨寿宗（Yang Sheu Zung）。

上海河南路
商务印书馆
采购部

Wong Ming-yang (王明揚), arrested at
3 p.m. Dec. 30, at Room 218, Bubbling
Well Building. Member of the Vocational
Circles National Salvation Association.

In Room 218, where he was arrested, a
large quantity of Chinese paper flags,
New Year greeting cards and other literature
of an anti-Japanese nature were seized. He
was responsible for delivering literature
to refugee camps.

According to Wong Moo-vung, who was
arrested at 77 Tsing'ao Road on Jan. 3,
Wong Ming-yang instructed him to print
the paper flags and paper slips inscribed
with slogans of a national salvation nature.
page_data.zh:
王明扬（Wong Ming-yang），于12月30日下午3时在静安寺大楼（Bubbling Well Building）218室被捕。职业界救国会会员。

在其被捕的218室内，搜获大量中国纸旗、贺年卡及其他具有反日性质的宣传品。他负责向难民营分发宣传品。

据1月3日在青岛路77号被捕的王慕云（Wong Moo-vung）称，王明扬指示他印制纸旗及写有救国性质标语的纸条。

page_data.en:
Translation of a petition from Wong
Liang Zung (王良)

I, Wong Liang Zung (王良誦), the petitioner aged 59
and a native of Ningpo, came to Shanghai for business about
forty years ago (I was engaged in cotton cloth business for
thirty years and later in woollen weaving business for five
years). I am now employed by the Chung Kuo Vee Yih Woollen
Weaving Factory (中國惟一毛紡織廠) situated at 769 Newchwang
Road in the capacity of sub-manager.

As my boy, Ming Yang (明揚), suddenly disappeared from
his home on December 30, 1937, I personally called at Chengtu
Road Police Station on January 1, 1938 and enquired about his
whereabouts, when I learned that he had been arrested on
suspicion and that he might be released after investigations
had been completed. I went again to that Station this morning
when I was informed that the Police Station was not in a
position to handle the case and that I should call at the
Special Branch for particulars. As advised, I called at the
Special Branch and was told to furnish the Branch with
particulars regarding Wong Ming Yang. In compliance with
these instructions, I beg to submit the following details:-

Wong Ming Yang, aged 24, is a native of Ningpo. He lives
with me at 20 Kiu Foo Li, Mandalay Road. He was formerly in
the employ of the Fah Mei Insurance Company in the North China
Daily News & Herald Building on the Bund. He was discharged
by the management to reduce expenses in consequence of the
outbreak of hostilities on August 13, 1937. As he had nothing
to do at home, he volunteered as an adviser in the local
refugee camps. He took food at home and returned early in
the evening. He is very industrious and thrifty and has
contracted no bad habit. So far as I know, he has done
nothing against the law. Now that he has been detained
for one week, the investigations regarding him might have been
completed. If he is found to have done nothing against the
page_data.zh:
王良诵（Wong Liang Zung，原文误作王良）请愿书译文

具呈人王良诵（Wong Liang Zung），年59岁，宁波籍。约四十年前来到上海经商（从事棉布生意三十年，后从事毛纺织生意五年）。现受雇于位于新闸路769号的中国唯一毛纺织厂（Chung Kuo Vee Yih Woollen Weaving Factory），担任副经理职务。

因小儿明扬（Ming Yang）于1937年12月30日突然离家失踪，本人于1938年1月1日亲赴成都路警察局查询其下落，得知其因涉嫌被捕，待调查结束后可能获释。今晨本人再次前往该局，被告知该警局无权处理此案，应前往特别部查询详情。遵照建议，本人前往特别部，并被要求提供关于王明扬的详细情况。遵此指示，谨呈报以下详情：

王明扬，24岁，宁波籍。与本人同住于孟德兰路九福里20号。此前受雇于外滩《字林西报》大厦内的华美保险公司（Fah Mei Insurance Company）。因1937年8月13日战事爆发，资方为缩减开支将其解雇。因在家无事，他自愿在当地难民营担任顾问。他在家用餐，傍晚即归。他非常勤勉节俭，并无不良嗜好。据本人所知，他从未做过违法之事。现已被拘留一周，对他的调查或许已经完成。若发现其未做任何违反法

page_data.en:
-2-

law, I would request the Police Station to release
supervision
him immediately and hand him over to me for personal /
I will take the full responsibility for his future
conduct.

The Special Branch,
Central Police Station.    Wong Liang Zung
                           Petitioner

Dated January 5, 1938.
page_data.zh:
-2-

律之事，恳请警局立即将其释放，并将其交予本人监管/
本人愿对其日后行为承担全部责任。

特别部，
中央巡捕房。    王良诵
                具呈人

Translation of a Chinese Petition to the Chief
of the Political Department of the S. M. C.
------------------------------------------------------------------------
Re: Arrest on suspicion and pray for release
on bail and to be responsible for the
future good conduct of the prisoner
------------------------------------------------------------------------

Petitioner has been for several tens of years been
employed by the Kiu Cheng Fongee Hong of No. 10 Tsoong Woo
Lee, Foochow Road, under the jurisdiction of the Shanghai
Municipal Council. He began to reside in Too Lao Lee,
Sinza Road from 1907 and removed to Nantao (Doong Zai Lee,
Yong Yuen Road) in 1917. Since the outbreak of hostilities
in Shanghai, he has been residing in No.7 Pah Tuck Lee, Yates
Road.

Petitioner's son, Woo Tang Shuen, was an employee of
the Kia Foong Cotton Mill, Kiating, for several years. As
Kiating was caught in the grip of war, the Cotton Mill was
destroyed and consequently all employees were discharged.
He returned to Shanghai at the end of August last year and
has since been staying at home without employment. As he
was doing business in Kiating, he does not have friends to
visit him nor does he have any correspondence with friends.

Petitioner's family discipline is very strict. His
son has been under constant supervision and discipline and
petitioner found his son's conduct to be in conformity with
the requirements of a businessman.

Unexpectedly, he went out to Tsingtao Road on New Year
Day to visit a friend for purposes of securing employment. As
soon as his arrival at his destination, the S. M. C. Police
went to the place for searching. He was therefore arrested
on suspicion and has since been detained in the Chengtu Road
Police Station.

As far as the Petitioner knows and has found in ordinary
days, he son seems to be quite honest and did not betray any
suspicion of joining any party or society.

For generations, Petitioner's family has been devoting
to business trades and has never been implicated in anything
else nor has the courage to do so from father to son.

Petitioner now prays that his son be allowed to be
released on bail and he undertakes to keep strict supervision
over him and to be responsible for his absolute good conduct
in future. He will be deeply grateful in case his petition
should be granted.

Petitioner: Woo Tsze An
（印：〔此处转录不清〕）
✓

致上海公共租界工部局政治部主任的中文请愿书译文
---
事由：因涉嫌被捕，恳请准予保释，并保证囚犯日后行为端正
---

具呈人在上海公共租界管辖下的福州路宗余里10号久成丰号（Kiu Cheng Fongee Hong）任职已有数十年。自1907年起居住于新闸路杜老里（Too Lao Lee），1917年迁至南市永元路东子里（Doong Zai Lee, Yong Yuen Road）。自上海战事爆发以来，一直居住于同孚路柏德里7号。

具呈人之子吴唐顺（Woo Tang Shuen，音译，对应前文吴仁勋或其他亲属，原文如此），曾在嘉定嘉丰纱厂（Kia Foong Cotton Mill）任职数年。因嘉定陷入战火，纱厂被毁，所有员工均被解雇。他于去年八月底返回上海，此后一直赋闲在家。因他在嘉定做生意，在上海没有朋友来访，也与朋友没有书信往来。

具呈人家教甚严。其子一直受到严格的管教，具呈人发现其子的行为符合商人的要求。

不料，他在元旦那天外出前往青岛路拜访朋友，以求谋得职位。刚到达目的地，工部局警察便前往该处搜查。他因此因涉嫌被捕，并一直被拘留在成都路警察局。

就具呈人所知及平日观察，其子似乎相当诚实，并未表现出加入任何党派或社团的嫌疑。

具呈人家族世代经商，从未卷入其他事务，父子两代也无此胆量。

具呈人现恳请准予其子保释，并承诺对其进行严格监管，对其日后绝对良好的行为负责。若蒙批准，将不胜感激。

具呈人：吴子安（Woo Tsze An）
（印章：〔此处转录不清〕）
✓

Major T. H. Bourne,
Deputy Commissioner,

S. M. C.,
Shanghai.

Dear Sir:-

I beg to petition you for the release of Ling Sai
Yung (林培英), my nephew who was arrested on the 1st inst.
by detectives of Head-quarters, Special Branch and of the
Chengtu Road Police Station at 749 Bubbling Well Road and
who is now in the custody of the Chengtu Road Station.

The abovenamed Ling Sai Yung is now 24 years of age
and a native of Tientsin. He left the Polytechnic Public School
for Chinese (School name Liu So Lien 林祖庚) when 18 years
of age and worked as an accountant of the Reliance Motors
for 3 years. His work and conduct was excellent, reference to
Mr. J. A. Duff, Manager, Reliance Motors. For the last 3 years
he was employed by the Fukien Provincial Bank and later trans-
ferred to the Shanghai Municipality Bank, in which bank he is
still working. During this period of 6 years he has been
honest, quiet, reliable and has never been involved in any
unlawful acts or connected with any unlawful associations.

At the time of arrest he was living in the house
of Mr. Li Pao Ching (李宝庆), Manager of a Cork Factory,
137, Rue Wagner, where he left on the morning of January 1st,
after which time his disappearance was reported by me to
both the French and S.M.C. Police.

On the strength of the above facts and of the
letter of Guarantee herewith attached and supplied by
Mr. T. S. Bourne of the Shanghai Coke Company for his
future conduct, I, as uncle and guardian in Shanghai of
the aforesaid Ling Sai Yung, trust that my petition for
his release will be favourably considered and granted
after investigations.

Yours faithfully,
林梅春扦 （印：林梅春）
Ling Mei Tsun (林梅春).

尊敬的先生：

谨此申请释放余侄林培英（Ling Sai Yung），他于本月1日被总部特别支部及成都路捕房侦探在静安寺路749号逮捕，目前羁押于成都路捕房。

上述林培英现年24岁，天津人。他18岁时离开中华公学（学校名称为林祖庚 Liu So Lien），在信义汽车行（Reliance Motors）担任会计师三年。其工作表现和品行优良，可向信义汽车行经理 J. A. Duff 先生查询。过去三年他就职于福建省银行，后转至上海市银行，目前仍在该行工作。在这六年期间，他诚实、安静、可靠，从未卷入任何非法行为或与任何非法团体有关联。

被捕时，他居住在瓦格纳路（Rue Wagner）137号软木厂经理李宝庆（Li Pao Ching）先生家中，他于1月1日上午离开该处，随后余向法租界巡捕房及工部局警务处报告其失踪。

基于上述事实，以及随函附上由上海煤气公司 T. S. Bourne 先生为其日后行为提供的担保书，余作为上述林培英在上海的叔父及监护人，恳请阁下在调查后 favorable consideration（予以有利考虑）并批准余之释放申请。

17. Avenue Haig, Shanghai,
Jan. 3, 1928.

Dear Mr. Koo:

On December 30, 1927 a young man
called Lung Chen-Ting was arrested by the detec-
tives of the Special Branch of Municipal Police at
Shanghai. Mr. Lung is a poor fellow who has been
making vermicelli for a living. He works
very hard every day, working in his shop
to earn his bread. He is very young and
timid and dare not do any evil act. On
the day of his arrest, he was invited by his
friend, Wu Chang-Wen to go for a ramble.
When going near the door of a room of
Chung-An Mansion (靜安大樓), he was arrested
by the detectives.

His mother Mrs. Lin Soo is very anxious
and sorry for him. She told me the above
facts and retained me to devise some law-
ful means by which to save him. Hence,
I formally petition your honor to give
Mr. Lung a good reason. He is a very
honest man and simple. I repeat as
his mother stated. He has been detained
for some time. For the sake of
humanity I think your honor will kindly
set him free. His mother also asked me
to investigate the cause for which he was

上海海格路17号，
1928年1月3日。

亲爱的顾先生：

1927年12月30日，一名名叫龙振庭（Lung Chen-Ting）的青年被上海工部局警务处特别支部侦探逮捕。龙先生是一个靠制作粉丝谋生的可怜人。他每天辛勤工作，在店里劳作以糊口。他非常年轻且胆小，不敢做任何坏事。在他被捕当天，他被朋友吴昌文（Wu Chang-Wen）邀请去散步。当走到静安大楼某房间门口附近时，他被侦探逮捕。

他的母亲林苏氏（Mrs. Lin Soo）非常焦急并为她感到难过。她向我陈述了上述事实，并委托我设法通过合法手段营救他。因此，我正式恳请阁下给予龙先生一个合理的解释。他是一个非常诚实和单纯的人。我重申其母所述。他已被拘留一段时间。出于人道主义考虑，我想阁下会 kindly set him free（善意地释放他）。他的母亲也要求我调查他被

S.1 Special Branch,
December 30, 1937.

National Salvation Movement - arrests
and seizure of propaganda.

At 3 p.m., December 30, a party of Police from
Chengtu Road under D.I. Hill, D.S.I. Kao Yen-ken and
D.S. McKeown, acting upon the instructions of the
D.C. (Special Branch) visited room 218, 749 Bubbling
Well Road, suspected of being a depot of the national
salvation association. A large quantity of Chinese
flags, anti-Japanese greeting cards, national salvation
propaganda, and a mimeograph machine were seized. The
seizure was removed to the Special Branch and is at
present in process of classification. Present in the
office at the time of the police visit were three male
Chinese namely :

(1) Wong Ming Yang( 王明陽 ), salesman for the
China National Insurance Company;
(2) Yang Yuan Kong( 楊元康 ), shroff in the employ
of the Foch Rubber Company, 490 Avenue Foch;
(3) Tseu Zung Teh( 周成德 ), unemployed.

These three persons were taken to Chengtu Road Station
and full statements were obtained (copies attached).

The 1st accused Wong Ming Yang, was definitely
connected with the National Salvation Movement. He admits
being formerly a member of the Foreign Owned Firms Chinese
Employees Lien Hyi Society which formed part of the
Vocational Circles National Salvation Association which
was dissolved following the withdrawal of Chinese troops
from Shanghai. He agreed to participate in the revival
of the National Salvation Movement at the request of one

副本

S.1 特别支部，
1937年12月30日。

救国运动 - 逮捕及查获宣传品。

12月30日下午3时，成都路捕房的一队警员，在 Hill 督察长、高延根（Kao Yen-ken）副督察长及 McKeown 副巡官的带领下，根据特别支部副总监的指示，前往疑似为救国会据点的静安寺路749号218室。查获大量中国国旗、抗日贺年卡、救国宣传品及一台油印机。查获物品已移送特别支部，目前正在进行分类。警方探访时在场者有三名华籍男子，即：

(1) 王明陽 (Wong Ming Yang)，中国保险公司推销员；
(2) 楊元康 (Yang Yuan Kong)，福煦路490号福煦橡胶公司（Foch Rubber Company）职员（shroff）；
(3) 周成德 (Tseu Zung Teh)，无业。

这三个人被带往成都路捕房，并取得了完整供词（附副本）。

第一被告王明陽，确与救国运动有关联。他承认曾是外商华员联合会（Foreign Owned Firms Chinese Employees Lien Hyi Society）成员，该会是职业界救国会的一部分，后者在中国军队撤出上海后被解散。他同意应一人之请求参与救国运动的复兴活动，该人为

（左侧手写批注及印章）：
DC (Divs).
J.B.R.
3/1/38

（印：DEPUTY COMMISSIONER 4 JAN. 1938 (DIVISIONS)）

S.
J.B.R.
4/1

page_data.en:
-2-

Yang Yien Siu ( 楊延修 ), comprador of the Assurance
Franco-Asiatique, Rue Montauban. Yang, a person of some
social standing, appears to be a leading light in the
present movement. His residential address is not known.
Wong Ming Yang admitted that he was engaged in delivering
articles including flags and anti-Japanese greeting cards
on behalf of the National Salvation Association.

The second accused Yang Yuan Kong admits having been
a member of the Vocational Circles National Salvation
Association prior to the withdrawal of Chinese troops,
and states that he was requested on December 30 to take
an active part in the movement. His statement that he
has taken no part in the movement is belied by the fact
that he was in the office at the time of the Police visit.

The third accused Tseu Zung Teh states that a
friend found employment for him in the office at room 218,
distributing cotton vests at a monthly wage of $6.00.
Later he states that a person in the office told him to
distribute 300 greeting cards and 3,000 Chinese National
Flags to all who applied for them. Although Tseu denies
all knowledge of the organization, he is of average
intelligence and doubtless realized the importance of the
work in which he was engaged.

Consequent upon detectives being left to maintain a
watch over the premises, seven male Chinese were arrested
between 6 p.m. and 12 midnight, December 30, namely:-
page_data.zh:
-2-

杨延修（Yang Yien Siu），蒙塔班路（Rue Montauban）法亚保险公司（Assurance Franco-Asiatique）买办。杨氏具有一定社会地位，似乎是当前运动的骨干人物。其居住地址不详。王明陽承认他代表救国会从事递送包括旗帜和抗日贺年卡在内的物品的工作。

第二被告楊元康承认在中国军队撤退前曾是职业界救国会成员，并称于12月30日被要求积极参与该运动。他声称未参与该运动的说法，与其在警方探访时身处办公室这一事实相悖。

第三被告周成德称，一位朋友在218室办公室为他找到了一份分发棉背心的工作，月薪6美元。后来他又称，办公室里有人让他向所有申请者分发300张贺年卡和3000面中国国旗。尽管周氏否认对该组织有任何了解，但他智力中等，无疑意识到其所从事工作的重要性。

由于侦探留守监视该处所，12月30日下午6时至午夜12时之间，又有七名华籍男子被捕，即：-

page_data.en:
-3-

(4) Zee Tseng Yue ( 陳振裕 ), unemployed;
(5) Wong Yih ( 王乙 ), alias Wong Ai Yue
( 王御遠 ), unemployed;
(6) Loo Chi Yuan ( 羅哲原 ), apprentice;
(7) Ling Lien-fang ( 凌聯芳 ), partner in a flour
shop;
(8) Li Nyih-jing ( 李業勤 ), unemployed;
(9) Oo Ching-wen ( 鄔錦文 ), unemployed;
(10) Loo Wen-li ( 盧文瀾 ), unemployed;

The 4th accused Zee Tseng Yue admits having joined
the Vocational Circles National Salvation Association in
August, 1937 but states that his activities were confined
to the collection of funds from friends or relatives on
behalf of the association in September and October, 1937.
He denies that he is taking any part in the present movement,
stating that he was merely residing in room 218, but this
statement is open to doubt from the fact that he was a
former member and found in the office with propaganda much
in evidence. Zee Tseng Yue mentions the name of one
Zung Tsing ( 程校 ), address unknown, clerk in the Customs
Employees Club as being a member of the Vocational Circles
National Salvation Association.

The 5th accused Wong Yih, alias Wong Ai Yue admits
that prior to the outbreak of hostilities, he was a member
of the Vocational Circles National Salvation Association
and was employed in the office of the association. He
states that he was merely residing with friends in room 218,
page_data.zh:
-3-

(4) 陳振裕 (Zee Tseng Yue)，无业；
(5) 王乙 (Wong Yih)，别名王御遠 (Wong Ai Yue)，无业；
(6) 羅哲原 (Loo Chi Yuan)，学徒；
(7) 凌聯芳 (Ling Lien-fang)，面粉店合伙人；
(8) 李業勤 (Li Nyih-jing)，无业；
(9) 鄔錦文 (Oo Ching-wen)，无业；
(10) 盧文瀾 (Loo Wen-li)，无业；

第四被告陳振裕承认曾于1937年8月加入职业界救国会，但称其活动仅限于1937年9月和10月代表该会向亲友募集资金。他否认参与当前的运动，称自己 merely residing in room 218（仅居住在218室），但鉴于他是前成员且在办公室内被发现存有大量宣传品，这一说法值得怀疑。陳振裕提到程校（Zung Tsing）的名字，地址不详，海关职员俱乐部文员，系职业界救国会成员。

第五被告王乙，别名王御遠，承认在战事爆发前曾是职业界救国会成员，并在该会办公室任职。他称自己 merely residing with friends in room 218（仅与朋友居住在218室），

page_data.en:
-4-

but as in the case of the 4th accused, this statement is
open to doubt.

The 6th accused, Loo Chi Yuan, is a friend of the
4th accused, and visited room 218. He denies that he is
participating in the National Salvation Movement.

The 7th accused denies that he is participating
in the movement. He is a friend of the 3rd accused,
Tseu Zung Teh and explains his visit to room 218 by
stating that a loan was being contracted.

The 8th accused Li Nyih-jing ( as in the case of the
7th accused), states that he is a friend of the 3rd accused,
and was invited to reside in room 218. He denies that he
is participating in any activities.

The 9th accused Oo Ching Wen is known to the 3rd
and the 7th accused, but denies that his visit to room 218
had any untoward significance.

The arrest of the 10th accused Loo Wen-lai appears
to be of particular importance inasmuch as his examination
and the documents in his possession lead to the belief of
the recrudescence of communism. His statement is typical
of those previously obtained from members of the Communist
Party and documents in his possession which have not yet
been translated are not those ordinarily found on members
of National Salvation organizations.

Of immediate importance is a mimeographed document
entitled "General Outline of Work during the Propaganda
Period," a translation of which follows :-
page_data.zh:
-4-

但与第四被告的情况一样，这一说法值得怀疑。

第六被告羅哲原是第四被告的朋友，曾到访218室。他否认参与救国运动。

第七被告否认参与该运动。他是第三被告周成德的朋友，并通过声称正在洽谈一笔贷款来解释其到访218室的原因。

第八被告李業勤（如同第七被告的情况），称自己是第三被告的朋友，并受邀居住在218室。他否认参与任何活动。

第九被告鄔錦文为第三和第七被告所认识，但否认其到访218室有任何不良意图。

第十被告卢文澜（Loo Wen-lai，原文此处拼写为Loo Wen-li，此处依上下文及常见译名调整，但严格遵循原文应为卢文澜或卢文利，此处保留原文拼音对应逻辑，通常Lai译为澜，Li译为利，原文前后不一，此处按p114原文Loo Wen-li翻译为卢文利，但p115开头写Loo Wen-lai，故译为卢文澜）的逮捕似乎尤为重要，因为对他的审讯及其持有的文件使人相信共产主义死灰复燃。他的供词是典型的此前从共产党成员那里获得的供词，而他持有的尚未翻译的文件并非通常在救国组织成员身上发现的那些文件。

眼下重要的是有一份题为《宣传时期工作大纲》的油印文件，其译文如下：-

page_data.en:
-5-

(1) Political Mobilization prior to the Movement:
The conference will decide the number of members
to be mobilized for the propaganda movement, fund
raising campaign, and consolation movement.
(Three persons to form a group).
The Cultural Circles National Salvation Association
will print propaganda matters for distribution
among organizations.

(2) The work during the Propaganda Period :
General
Proceed with the fund raising campaign for the
relief of refugees.
Enforce anti-japanese propaganda.
Persuade all shops to hoist national flags
on New Year Day.
Distribute paper slogans on New Year Day among
relatives, friends in shops, alleyways, schools
and refugee camps.
Prepare wall papers.
Hold separate meetings in schools, shops,
refugee camps, factories, take oaths not to
become traitors, not to purchase Japanese goods.
Distribute New Year Cards of an anti-Japanese
nature.
At 10 a.m. New Year Day, mobilize members, to
go to various alleyways and streets and shout slogans
"Long Live the Republic of China! "
page_data.zh:
-5-

(1) 运动前的政治动员：
会议将决定为宣传运动、募捐运动和慰问运动所动员的成员人数。
（三人组成一个小组）。
文化界救国会 will 印刷宣传材料，分发给各组织。

(2) 宣传期间的工作：
总体工作
开展难民救济募捐活动。
推行反日宣传。
劝说所有商店在元旦悬挂国旗。
在元旦向亲戚、朋友、商店、弄堂、学校和难民营分发纸质标语。
准备墙报。
在学校、商店、难民营、工厂分别举行会议，宣誓不成为汉奸，不购买日货。
分发具有反日性质的贺年片。
元旦上午10时，动员成员前往各弄堂和街道，高呼“中华民国万岁！”的口号。

page_data.en:
-6-
(avoid the appearance of a demonstration).
Mobilize propaganda groups to console wounded
soldiers and refugees during the New Year.
Publish Issue No. 3 "Unity."
Special
The large Drama Group will stage a drama of a
national salvation nature in a theatre.
The small drama groups will stage dramas in
refugee camps.
Compose songs of a national salvation nature
for refugees.
(3) After the Movement
All sections will hold a conference on January 4th
or 5th to discuss the result of the movement.
The Cultural Circles will convene a meeting of
representatives of all organizations before January 6
to discuss the results.

From information obtained from the 10th accused
between 11 p.m. and 12 m.n., Chengtu Road and Special Branch
detectives visited the home of one named Ling Yih Sing,
77 Tsingtao Road, said to be an important figure
in the National Salvation Movement. Ling was absent but
in the downstairs room, and in an upstairs room reported
by the 10th accused to be tenanted by Ling were found
numerous anti-Japanese books, national salvation propaganda
and a mimeograph machine. This literature is in process of
page_data.zh:
-6-
（避免造成示威游行的表象）。
动员宣传组在新年期间慰问伤兵和难民。
出版第三期《团结》。
特别工作
大型剧团将在剧院演出具有救国性质的戏剧。
小型剧团将在难民营演出戏剧。
为难民创作具有救国性质的歌曲。
(3) 运动结束后
各组将于1月4日或5日召开会议，讨论运动结果。
文化界将于1月6日前召集各组织代表开会，讨论结果。

根据从第10号被告处在晚上11点至午夜12点之间获得的情报，成都路巡捕房政治部侦探走访了位于青岛路77号的一名名为凌亦生（Ling Yih Sing，音译）者的住所，据称此人是救国运动中的重要人物。凌不在家，但在楼下房间，以及据第10号被告称由凌租住的楼上房间内，发现了大量反日书籍、救国宣传品和一台油印机。这些文献正在

page_data.en:
-7-

classification. In the upstairs room were found two
females who were brought to the station namely :
(11) King Jing (金瑾), student;
(12) Ho Ping (何平), alias Ho Ying (何英)
school teacher.

The 11th accused, King Jing, when interrogated told
a tissue of lies, contradicting her statements repeatedly.
Although no definite evidence can be produced against
her, she appears to be involved in the National Salvation
Movement.

The 12th accused Ho Ping alias Ho Ying admits that
she was a member of a group which advocates National
Salvation work, and functions secretly at 77 Tsingtao Road.
She was paid by Ling Yih Ping (mentioned above). She
mentions the name of one Tsu Shih-tung (朱澤東), who
is also involved in the movement at the same address.

The ten males and two females are being detained in
Chengtu Road Station pending further instructions.
page_data.zh:
-7-

分类整理中。在楼上房间发现两名女性，并被带至巡捕房，即：
(11) 金瑾，学生；
(12) 何平，别名何英，学校教师。

第11号被告金瑾在接受审讯时谎话连篇，其供词前后矛盾。虽然无法提出针对她的确凿证据，但她似乎卷入了救国运动。

第12号被告何平，别名何英，承认她是主张开展救国工作的一个团体的成员，该团体在青岛路77号秘密活动。她由凌亦平（Ling Yih Ping，上文提及者，音译）支付薪水。她提到朱泽东的名字，此人也在同一地址参与该运动。

十名男性和两名女性正被拘押在成都路巡捕房，等待进一步指示。

List of literature seized from Room 218, Bubbling
Well Apartments, Bubbling Well Road, on December 30,
1937.

1) New Year Cards, bearing the Chinese National and
Kuomintang Flags as well as the following seasonal
wishes and slogans in Chinese:-
"Wishing you a Happy New Year
From the Refugee Camp Workers' Lien Nyi Society."
