Wong Ming Yang （王明揚）
Ningpo                                      D.S.  McKeown
Chengtu Rd. Stn.    30/12/37                D.S.I. Kao Yen Ken

My name is Wong Ming Yang, aged 24, a native of Ningpo,
and married. I am a salesman of the China National Insurance
Company, China Land Bank Building, corner of Peking and Kiangse
Roads, and reside at 20 Kiu Foh Li, Mandalay Road. I am a
member of the Foreign Owned Firms Chinese Employees Lien
Nyi Society, formerly situated at 115 Hankow Road and now at
Pootung Bank Building (2nd floor), corner of Avenue Ed. VII
and Honan Road, which was part of the Vocational Circles
National Salvation Association. Automatically I became
member of the national salvation association, which was
dissolved following the withdrawal of the Chinese forces.

At the end of November 1937, Yang Yien Siu (楊延修),
compradore of the Assurance Franco-Asiatique, Rue Montauban,
and concurrently a staff member of the Organization Section of
the Foreign Owned Firms Chinese Employees' Lien Nyi Society,
asked me to assist him in conducting national salvation works/
among refugees. He belongs to the Vocational Circles National
Salvation Association, with secret offices the addresses of
which I do not know. Although I am a member of this organiza-
tion, I merely receive orders from Yang. The work among the
refugees is a part of the programme of the Vocational Circles
National Salvation Association." My principal work is to
deliver articles, including flags and cards. Although a
number of persons work in this organization, I only know the
following persons :-

1. Yang Yien Siu
2. Yang Yuan Kong (in custody).
page_data.zh:
王明扬
宁波                                      D.S. McKeown
成都路巡捕房    1937年12月30日                D.S.I. 高恩肯

我叫王明扬，24岁，宁波人，已婚。我是中国保险公司的推销员，公司地址位于北京路与江西路转角的中国银行大楼，居住在曼达莱路久福里20号。我是外商华员联益社的成员，该社原址位于汉口路115号，现址位于爱多亚路与河南路转角的浦东银行大楼（二楼），该社是职业界救国会的一部分。我自动成为救国会会员，该会在国军撤退后解散。

1937年11月底，蒙脱班路（Rue Montauban）法亚保险公司买办、同时兼任外商华员联益社组织科职员的杨延修，请我协助他在难民中开展救国工作。他属于职业界救国会，其秘密办公地点的地址我并不知晓。虽然我是该组织的成员，但我仅接受杨的命令。在难民中的工作是职业界救国会计划的一部分。”我的主要工作是递送物品，包括旗帜和卡片。虽然有许多人在该组织工作，但我只认识以下人员：

1. 杨延修
2. 杨元孔（在押）。

page_data.en:
- 2 -

3. Wong Moo Vung ( 王茂文 ), unemployed, living in Room 218,
Bubbling Well Building, Bubbling Well Road, who deals
with the printing of the cards and other matters.
4. Chun hung ( 春 洪 ), a school teacher by profession,
whereabouts unknown.

I understand that all the other work is detailed to persons
by Yang Yien Siu. Room 218 was formerly occupied by the
Native Bank Employees Lien Nyi Society and vacated about three
days ago. From the commencement of December up to now, I and
the other members used the room as a communication address.
Through the arrangements made by Wong Moo Vung, a quantity of
flags, cards, printed matter as well as a mimeograph were
brought to the room about two or three days ago.

With regard to the "Refugee Camp Workers' Lien Nyi Society,"
I understand that before the withdrawal of Chinese troops from
Shanghai, the Vocational Circles National Salvation Association
convened meetings of a number of workers of refugee camps
from time to time, and thus they formed an organization known
as the "Refugee Camp Workers' Lien Nyi Society." I also
know that Chun Hung is the member of the Vocational Circles
National Salvation Association who communicates with the
Refugee Camp Workers Lien Nyi Society.

At about 2.30 p.m. December 30, I arrived at the room
in the Bubbling Well Building, Bubbling Well Road, with a view
to discussing with Wong Moo Vung the distribution of the flags,
cards and a periodical entitled "Friends of Refugees" to
various refugee camps before the New Year. While I was waiting
for him, the Police came and took me to Chengtu Road Station.
page_data.zh:
- 2 -

3. 王茂文（Wong Moo Vung），无业，居住于静安寺路静安大楼218室，负责印刷卡片及其他事务。
4. 春洪（Chun hung），职业为教师，下落不明。

据我所知，所有其他工作均由杨延修（Yang Yien Siu）分派给各人。218室原由华商银行职员联益社占用，约于三天前搬空。自十二月初至今，我与其他成员将该房间用作通讯联络地址。通过王茂文的安排，大约两三天前，一批旗帜、卡片、印刷品以及一台油印机被带入该房间。

关于“难民收容所工人联益社”，据我了解，在中国军队撤离上海之前，职业界救国会不时召集各难民收容所的工人开会，从而组建了一个名为“难民收容所工人联益社”的组织。我也知道春洪是职业界救国会的成员，负责与难民收容所工人联益社进行联络。

12月30日下午2时30分左右，我抵达静安寺路静安大楼的房间，打算与王茂文讨论在新年前向各难民收容所分发旗帜、卡片及一份名为《难友》的期刊事宜。当我正在等待他时，警察到来并将我带至成都路捕房。

page_data.en:
- 3 -

All the addresses of various refugee camps as well as the flags,
cards, and the periodical are in the charge of Wong Moo Vung.
It was intended that a parcel be delivered to Jen Chi Tang
Benevolent Society, 35 Yunnan Road, for distribution among its
refugee camps and distribution to other camps be dealt with by me
and my assistant Yang Yuan Kong (in custody).

I do not know the present secret organization of the
Vocational Circles National Salvation Association. I only
know Yang Yien Siu under whom I work in the Association.

As to Yang Yuan Kong, I met him at the corner of Bubbling
Well and Yates Roads at about 10 a.m. December 30 and as he
is my friend and also a member of the Vocational Circles
National Salvation Association, I asked him to attend Room 218
Bubbling Well Building, Bubbling Well Road and help to deliver
parcels.
page_data.zh:
- 3 -

各难民收容所的所有地址以及旗帜、卡片和期刊均由王茂文负责保管。原本计划将一个包裹送至云南路35号的仁济堂善会，由其在其管理的难民收容所中进行分发，而向其他收容所的分发工作则由我和我的助手杨元康（在押）负责处理。

我不了解职业界救国会目前的秘密组织架构。我只认识我在该会中受其领导的杨延修。

关于杨元康，我于12月30日上午10时左右在静安寺路与 Yates 路（今新闸路）转角处遇见他。鉴于他是我的朋友，也是职业界救国会的成员，我便请他前往静安寺路静安大楼218室，协助运送包裹。

page_data.en:
Yang Yuan Kong (楊元康)
Ningpo                                      D.S. McKeown
Chengtu Rd. Stn.    30/12/37                D.S.I. Kao Yen Ken

My name is Yang Yuan Kong, aged 24, native of Ningpo,
and a shroff in the employ of the Foch Rubber Co., 490
Avenue Foch. I reside on the premises of the firm.
At about 10 a.m. December 30, at the corner of Bubbling
Well and Yates Roads, I met Wong Ming Yang (王明揚), now in
custody, a salesman in the employ of the China Insurance Co.,
Avenue Joffre (formerly situated on Szechuen Road), who was
a fellow member of the Vocational Circles National Salvation
Association prior to the withdrawal of Chinese troops from
Shanghai. He told me that as the situation was very tense,
workers for the national salvation movement were few and that
it was proposed that national flags should be hoisted in
refugee camps in celebration of the New Year Festival. He did
not tell me who proposed the movement. He requested me to
call at his "place," Room 218 Bubbling Well Building, Bubbling
Well Road, off Carter Road, at 2 p.m. and take a bundle of
national flags to the Jen Chi Tang Benevolent Society, 35
Yunnan Road, which takes charge of a part of local refugee
camps. At 2.30 p.m. I arrived at the room where I met Wong
and was given a bundle of flags with instructions to take it
to the Refugee Reception Section of the Jen Chi Tang (i.e.
the Disaster Relief Federation of Shanghai Benevolent Societies)
I have not engaged in any "national salvation" activities
since the withdrawal of the Chinese troops, when all local
national salvation associations were dissolved. I learned
recently from my friends that these associations had lately
endeavoured to resume operations secretly and were maintaining
page_data.zh:
杨元康（楊元康）
宁波                                      D.S. McKeown
成都路捕房    1937年12月30日                巡官高恩坚（Kao Yen Ken）

我叫杨元康，24岁，宁波人，受雇于福煦路490号福昌橡胶公司担任出纳员。我居住在公司宿舍内。
12月30日上午10时左右，在静安寺路与 Yates 路（今新闸路）转角处，我遇见了目前在押的王明扬（Wong Ming Yang），他是霞飞路（原位于四川路）中国保险公司的推销员，在中国军队撤离上海之前，我们曾是职业界救国会的同事。他告诉我，由于局势非常紧张，从事救国运动的工作人员很少，有人提议在难民收容所悬挂国旗以庆祝新年。他并未告知我是谁提出了这一倡议。他请求我于下午2时前往他的“地点”，即卡特路（今黄河路）旁静安寺路静安大楼218室，取一包国旗送往云南路35号的仁济堂善会，该机构负责管理本地部分难民收容所。下午2时30分，我到达该房间，见到了王某，并收到一包旗帜，奉命将其送往仁济堂的难民接待部（即上海慈善团体联合救灾会）。
自中国军队撤离、本地各救国会解散以来，我未参与任何“救国”活动。近期我从朋友处获悉，这些协会最近试图秘密恢复运作，并维持着

page_data.en:
- 2 -
offices in private houses. Meanwhile these organizations are
in close touch with each other. The workers of these bodies
are few. The room in the Bubbling Well Building is temporarily
occupied for national salvation activities in refugee camps.
It is the first time that I visited the room on the afternoon
of December 30. I do not know the names of the promoters of
the national salvation movement and I can give no information
concerning their meeting places.

(Signed) : Yang Yuan Kong.
page_data.zh:
- 2 -
在私人住宅中设立的办事处。同时，这些组织之间保持密切联系。这些机构的工作人员很少。静安大楼的房间是临时占用，用于开展难民收容所的救国活动。这是我第一次于12月30日下午访问该房间。我不知道救国运动发起人的姓名，也无法提供有关他们集会地点的信息。

（签名）：杨元康。

page_data.en:
Tseu Zung Teh (周成德)
Ningpo                                      D.S. McKeown
Chengtu Rd Stn          30/12/37            Clerk Loh Wei Kong

My name is Tseu Zung Teh, age 18, native of Ningpo,
single and unemployed.
    Following the outbreak of the local Sino-Japanese
hostilities, I left for Ningpo and remained at my native
place until December 4 when I returned here by steamer, with
a view to seeking employment.    After returning, I stayed in
the premises of the Kuh Sung Company, a cotton exchange
agency, No. 1 Szechuen Road, now closed, where I was formerly
employed as a telephone operator.    (It was a Chinese concern,
but the manager was Japanese).    Four days later I left this
place and went to reside with my friend Woo Dah-ming (鄔達明),
room 15, 110 Avenue Edward VII.    Woo formerly was also
employed by the Kuh Sung Company as an accountant.
    During the afternoon of December 12, at about
2 p.m., I went to see Zee Tseng-yue (徐振裕), a friend
of mine, and an apprentice of the Van Foong (萬豐) Cereal
Hong, No. 1 Szechuen Road, at his place of employment, and
requested him to seek employment for me.    He promised to
consider my request.    On the forenoon of December 13, Zee
Tseng-yue came to see me at Room 15, 110 Avenue Edward VII,
and told me to see one named Zung (程), at 10 Doong Yih
Li, Bubbling Well Road.    I accordingly went there on
the afternoon of the same day, when Zung asked me to take
care of old cotton clothes contributed by the public for
the relief of refugees, and promised me a monthly subsidy
of $6.00.    I went to Room 218, Bubbling Well Apartments
page_data.zh:
周成德（Tseu Zung Teh）
宁波                                      D.S. McKeown
成都路捕房          1937年12月30日            书记员罗伟刚（Loh Wei Kong）

我叫周成德，18岁，宁波人，未婚，无业。
本地中日战事爆发后，我前往宁波，并在家乡停留至12月4日，随后乘轮船返回此地，以求谋职。回来后，我住在四川路1号枯松公司（Kuh Sung Company，一家棉花交易所代理机构，现已关闭）的 premises 内，我曾受雇于该公司担任电话接线员。（这是一家华商企业，但经理是日本人）。四天后，我离开该处，搬去与我的朋友邬达明（Woo Dah-ming）同住，地址为爱德华七世路110号15室。邬以前也受雇于枯松公司担任会计。
12月12日下午2时左右，我去看望我的朋友徐振裕（Zee Tseng-yue），他是四川路1号万丰粮行的学徒，在他工作的地方，请求他为我谋求职位。他答应考虑我的请求。12月13日上午，徐振裕来到爱德华七世路110号15室看我，并告诉我去静安寺路东义里10号见一位姓程（Zung）的人。我遂于当日下午前往，程某让我负责照料公众捐赠用于救济难民的旧棉衣，并承诺每月给我6美元补贴。我去了静安公寓

page_data.en:
- 2 -

on December 15, by order of Zung, where I met Wong Mou-wen
(王慕文), who claimed to be a member of the Refugee Camp
Workers' Lien Nyi Society. Zung told me to receive some
80 old cotton padded vests sent by a certain person, and
instructed me to distribute them to all persons who visited
the room and applied for them. Some 70 of these vests were
distributed, while the remainder are still being kept in the
room.

Before December 15, I was living with Woo Dah-ming
in Room 15, 110 Avenue Edward VII, and Zee Tseng-yue, who
had resigned from the Van Foong Cereal Hong, also came to
stay with us on December 14. Due to the fact that Woo
Dah-ming objected to us living in his room, Zee Tseng-yue
and I removed to the room above the Keng Sing Li (耕莘里,
Weihaiwei Road, where we stayed until December 27, when I
removed to Room 218, Bubbling Well Apartments, Bubbling Well
Road, on the morning, and Zee Tseng-yue also removed to this
address during the afternoon of the same day. Zee, however,
came to occupy the room on December 28.

On December 28, Wong Mou-wen showed me some 3,000
copies of the Chinese National Flag printed on paper, and
300 new year greeting cards kept in the room, and told me
to distribute them to all persons who called at the room
and applied for them. On the forenoon of December 29,
three Chinese (all about thirty years of age), claiming
to be members of refugee camps, came to the room, and each
produced a chit and asked for the issue of the flags and
page_data.zh:
- 2 -

218室，时间是12月15日，这是遵照程某的命令去的，在那里我遇到了王慕文（Wong Mou-wen），他自称是难民收容所工人联益社的成员。程某让我接收某人送来的约80件旧棉背心，并指示我将它们分发给所有来到房间申请的人。其中约70件已分发，其余仍存放在房间内。

12月15日之前，我与邬达明同住于爱德华七世路110号15室，已从万丰粮行辞职的徐振裕也于12月14日来与我们同住。由于邬达明反对我们住在他的房间里，徐振裕和我搬到了威海卫路耕莘里（Keng Sing Li）楼上的房间，我们一直住到12月27日。当天上午，我搬到了静安寺路静安公寓218室，徐振裕也在当天下午搬到了这个地址。不过，徐是在12月28日才正式入住该房间的。

12月28日，王慕文给我看了存放在房间里的约3000份纸质印刷的中国国旗和300张新年贺卡，并让我将它们分发给所有来到房间申请的人。12月29日上午，三名中国人（年龄均在三十岁左右）来到房间，自称是难民收容所成员，每人出示了一张纸条，要求领取旗帜和

page_data.en:
- 3 -

new year greeting cards. I accordingly distributed to
each of them some 100 copies of the paper flag. Since
then no one has visited the room.
I have no knowledge regarding the organization
of the Refugee Camp Workers' Lien-Nyi Society.

Signed : Tseu Zung Teh.
page_data.zh:
- 3 -

新年贺卡。于是我向每人分发了约100份纸质旗帜。此后无人再来过该房间。
我对难民收容所工人联益社的组织情况一无所知。

签名：周成德。

page_data.en:
Zee Tseng Yue (許振裕)
Ningpo                                      D.S. Mckeown
Cehngtu Rd. Stn.        30/12/37            Clerk Liao Chung Chien

My name is Zee Tseng Yue, aged 21, native of Ningpo,
single. I am unemployed, formerly working as a clerk in
the Van Foong (萬丰) Cereal Hong, 120 Avenue Edward VII, and
leaving the employment on December 14 1937 owing to trade
depression. I reside in Room 218, Bubbling Well Apartments,
Bubbling Well Road to which address I removed on December 27.
I joined the Vocational Circles National Salvation
Association in August 1937 when it was situated in the Sing
Kwan Primary School, Chungking Road. I was also a member of
the Cereal Hong Employees Lien Nyi Club, Min Kuo Road, which
was dissolved after the withdrawal of the Chinese forces
from Shanghai.
Although I was a member of the Vocational Circles
National Salvation Association I did not take part in its
activities except soliciting funds from friends and relatives
on its behalf on two occasions in September and October,
1937, respectively.
My friend Tseu Zung Teh (周成達) was formerly employed
by Kah Sung Co., No.1 Szechuen Rd., and is at present unemployed.
On December 13, 1937, I introduced him to Mr. Zung Tsing (莊俊)
who is a clerk in the Customs Employees Club, Deng Yih Li,
Bubbling Well Road, and a member of the Shanghai Vocational
Circles National Salvation Association. On the instructions
of Zung Tsing, Tseu Zung Teh on 15/12/37 went to Room 218
Bubbling Apartments, Bubbling Well Road, and collected at that
addressed funds raised by members of the Association.
On December 14, 1937, when I was discharged by the Van
page_data.zh:
许振裕（Zee Tseng Yue）
宁波                                      D.S. Mckeown
成都路捕房        1937年12月30日            书记员廖忠健（Liao Chung Chien）

我叫许振裕，21岁，宁波人，未婚。我目前无业，此前在爱德华七世路120号万丰粮行担任职员，因生意萧条于1937年12月14日离职。我居住在静安寺路静安公寓218室，我是于12月27日搬至此处的。
1937年8月，当职业界救国会设在重庆路兴权小学时，我加入了该会。我也是民国路粮行职员联益俱乐部的成员，该俱乐部在中国军队撤离上海后解散。
虽然我是职业界救国会的成员，但我并未参与其活动，除了在1937年9月和10月分别两次代表该会向亲友募捐外。
我的朋友周成达（Tseu Zung Teh，注：此处英文拼写与上文周成德 Tseu Zung Teh 略有不同，且中文名写作周成达，依原文翻译）此前受雇于四川路1号 Kah Sung 公司，目前无业。1937年12月13日，我将他介绍给庄俊（Zung Tsing）先生，庄先生是静安寺路东义里海关职员俱乐部的职员，也是上海职业界救国会的成员。根据庄俊的指示，周成达于1937年12月15日前往静安寺路静安公寓218室，并在该地址收取了该会成员募集的资金。
1937年12月14日，当我被万

page_data.en:
- 2 -

Foong Cereal Hong, I went to live with one Wu Tah Ming (鄔達明)
and Tseu Zung Tah (周成杰), both of whom are my friends, at
No. 110 Avenue Edward VII. I had at the time a sum of $70.00
which I had saved from my monthly wages. I have spent about
$14.00 for food and locomotion during the past fifteen days
and have at present $56.00 in hand.

While Tseu Zung Teh attended the Bubbling Well Apartments
daily, I went out to call on my friends and relatives with a
view to securing employment. At the same time I also approached
one Waung Tse Tsang (汪子章), an employee of the Yung Dah
Cereal Hong, Rue Montauban, with the object of organizing a
food and fuel supply agency.

On December 16, Tseu and Wu had a quarrel over money and
consequently I and Tseu removed to a room above the Keng Sing
Li (明華里) Alleyway, Weihaiwei Road, where we resided up
to December 27 when we went to reside in Room 218 Bubbling Well
Apartments.

Room No. 218 was also shared by two other persons, one
named Wong Moo Vang (王泉文), while the name of the other
I do not know. They had resided in the room before we removed
there. I knew that Wong Moo Vang was employed in a certain
refugee camp. I had not had much conversation with him because
I used to go out during the day to see my friends and relatives.

I am not so much interested in the national salvation
movement as my employment and I do not know what activities
the Vocational Circles National Salvation Association is
undertaking.

(Signed) Zee Tseng Yue.
page_data.zh:
- 2 -

丰粮行解雇时，我去与我的朋友邬达明（Wu Tah Ming）和周成杰（Tseu Zung Tah，注：此处英文名与上文周成德/周成达均不同，依原文音译）同住，地址为爱德华七世路110号。当时我有从月薪中积攒下来的70美元。在过去的十五天里，我花费了约14美元用于食物和交通，目前手头尚有56美元。

当周成德每天前往静安公寓时，我则外出拜访亲友，以期找到工作。同时，我还接触了蒙托邦路（Rue Montauban，今梦花路）永大粮行的员工汪子章（Waung Tse Tsang），目的是组织一个食品及燃料供应机构。

12月16日，周和吴因金钱问题发生争吵，因此我和周搬到了威海卫路明华里（Keng Sing Li，注：此处中文标注为明华里，与前文耕莘里不同，依原文括号内中文翻译）巷弄楼上的一个房间，我们一直居住到12月27日，随后搬入静安公寓218室。

218室还由另外两人合租，一人名叫王泉文（Wong Moo Vang），另一人的姓名我不知道。在我们搬去之前，他们就住在这个房间里。我知道王泉文受雇于某个难民收容所。我与他交谈不多，因为我白天常出去拜访亲友。

相较于救国运动，我更关心我的就业问题，我不了解职业界救国会正在进行什么活动。

（签名）许振裕。

page_data.en:
王衍遠
Wong Yih ( 王 乙 ) alias Wong Ai Yue
Shing Hwa(新化),Kiangsu D.S. McKeown.
Chengtu Rd.Stn Dec.30,1937 Clerk Zung.

My name is Wong Yih alias Wong Ai Yue. I am 24 years of age, a native of Shing Hwa(新化), Kiangsu, single, and unemployed at present. I am living at the Refugees Camp Workers' Lien Nyi Society, Room 218 Bubbling Well Apartments, Bubbling Well Road.

Prior to the outbreak of the Sino-Japanese hostilities, I was employed in the King Nyi(景藝) Flower Shop, 400 Tiendong Road, and shortly after the outbreak of the hostilities, I went to my native place, Shing Hwa, Kiangsu, as the shop suspended business.

On December 24, I returned to Shanghai as I believed that the shop would reopen in the near future. Upon arrival I went to live with my friend named Wong Mou-vung (王慕文), at the Refugees Camp Workers' Lien Nyi Society, room 218, Bubbling Well Apartments, Bubbling Well Road.

I met Wong Mou-vung for the first time about three months ago, when I was still in Shanghai, in the club of bank and native bank employees, then situated in room 218 Bubbling Well Apartments, through the introduction of one Yuan Ching Wei(袁青衛) who was formerly one of my fellow workers in the Chinese National Goods Emporium, Continental Banking Building, Nanking Road, and whose present whereabouts I do not know.

As far as I know, Wong Mou-vung is an officer of the Refugees Camp Workers' Lien Nyi Society, and undertakes the education of refugees. Apart from living with him as I am unable to find some other place, I have no connections with Wong Mou-vung. I am not engaged in any national
page_data.zh:
王衍遠
Wong Yih ( 王 乙 )，又名 Wong Ai Yue
籍贯：江苏新化。警官：D.S. McKeown。
成都路捕房，1937年12月30日。记录员：Zung。

我叫王衍遠，又名王爱月（音译）。我今年24岁，江苏新化人，未婚，目前无业。我住在静安寺路静安公寓218室难民收容所工作人员联义社。

在中日敌对行动爆发之前，我在提篮桥路400号景藝花店工作，敌对行动爆发后不久，因花店停业，我回到了家乡江苏新化。

12月24日，我认为该店不久将重新开业，便返回上海。抵达后，我去和朋友王慕文同住，地址是静安寺路静安公寓218室难民收容所工作人员联义社。

我大约三个月前第一次见到王慕文，当时我还在上海，地点是静安公寓218室的银行及钱庄职员俱乐部，是由袁青衛介绍的。袁青衛以前是我在南京路大陆银行大楼中国国货公司的同事，目前下落不明。

据我所知，王慕文是难民收容所工作人员联义社的一名干事，负责难民教育工作。除了因为找不到其他地方而与他同住外，我与王慕文没有任何其他联系。我没有从事任何救国

page_data.en:
(2)

salvation work at present.
    I admit I was a member of the Shanghai Vocational
Circles Association to Save the Nation prior to my departure
for my native place.  I was employed in the office of the
association in the Sing Kwai Primary School, Park Road, as
a general duty clerk, and I did not undertake any propaganda
work.    I remained there for about twenty days and then
the association was closed by the Police.  After this, I
went to my native place and returned here only recently.

                    (Signed) Wong Yih.
page_data.zh:
(2)

工作。
    我承认，在离开家乡之前，我是上海职业界救国会
的成员。我在公园路辛圭小学（音译）的协会办事处担任
普通办事员，并未从事任何宣传工作。我在那里待了大约
二十天，随后该会被警方关闭。此后，我回到了家乡，直
到最近才回到这里。

                    （签名）王衍遠。

page_data.en:
Loo Chi Yuan (羅智源)
Shanghai                                      D.S. McKeown
Chengtu Rd Stn.      30/12/37                 Clerk Zung Zoong-oen

My name is Loo Chi Yuan (羅智源). I am nineteen
years of age, a native of Shanghai, unmarried. I have
been working as an apprentice in the Tsing Yuan Cereal Hong
(義泰豆麥行), upper portion of the Sing Kee Shipping
Hong (新記航運行), Rue du Consulat, French Concession,
for about three years, and I am living there.
About two or three days ago, my friend Lee Tseng-yue
(李振裕), ex-employee of the Van Foong Cereal Hong,
called on me at my place of employment. He informed me
that he was unemployed and asked me to visit him at Room
218, Bubbling Well Apartments, Bubbling Well Road, whenever
I had time, explaining that he desired to have a conversation
with me. At about 6 p.m., December 30, I left my place of
employment for the Bubbling Well Apartments. Unexpectedly
I was arrested by the Police upon entering Room 218 where
I expected to meet my friend. I do not know the reason of
my arrest, and I have no knowledge of the business that my
friend was doing.

Signed : Loo Chi Yuan
page_data.zh:
羅智源
上海                                          警官：D.S. McKeown
成都路捕房      1937年12月30日                 记录员：Zung Zoong-oen

我叫羅智源。我十九岁，上海人，未婚。我在法租界领事馆路新記航運行楼上的義泰豆麥行当学徒已有约三年时间，并住在那里。
大约两三天前，我的朋友李振裕（前万丰豆麦行雇员）到我工作的地方来访。他告诉我他失业了，并请我有空时去静安寺路静安公寓218室找他，解释说他想和我谈谈。12月30日下午6点左右，我离开工作地点前往静安公寓。没想到，当我进入218室准备见朋友时，被警察逮捕。我不知道被捕的原因，也不了解我朋友在做什么生意。

签名：羅智源

page_data.en:
Ling Lien-fang (凌联芳)
Shanghai                                      D.S. McKeown
Chengtu Rd Stn.          30/12/37              D.S.I. Kao Yen-ken

My name is Ling Lien-fang, aged 21, a native of
Shanghai and single. I am a partner of the Woo Sung
(和生) Flour Shop, 41 Wuting Road. I am living in
house 65 Chao Ka Jao off Hart Road.

I am not a member of the Vocational Circles
National Salvation Association nor of the Refugee Camp
Workers' Lien Hui Society.

At 5 p.m., December 29, Tseu Zung-tah (周成德),
a friend of mine, who worked with me as a clerk in the
Kuh Sung Firm, a Japanese cotton yarn exchange agency,
No.1 Szechuen Road, before the local hostilities, came to
the Woo Sung Flour Shop, 41 Wuting Road and asked me to
lend him $10 as capital to enter the coal business.
At that time he told me that he lived in Room 218,
Bubbling Well Apartments, Bubbling Well Road and worked
on behalf of refugees. As to the loan, I promised to try
to get some money for him, and he stated that he would
call on me again at 6 p.m. December 30. At this hour,
however, he failed to turn up. As I could not get any
money for him, I decided to give him a reply. So with my
friend Oo Ching-yung (邹锦云) I went to Room 218,
Bubbling Well Apartments, where we were taken by detectives
to Chengtu Road Station.

Signed : Ling Lien-fang.
page_data.zh:
凌联芳
上海                                          警官：D.S. McKeown
成都路捕房          1937年12月30日              高级探员：Kao Yen-ken

我叫凌联芳，21岁，上海人，未婚。我是吴淞路41号和生面粉店的合伙人。我住在哈特路附近的赵家桥65号。

我不是职业界救国会的成员，也不是难民收容所工作人员联益社的成员。

12月29日下午5点，我的朋友周成德来到吴淞路41号和生面粉店。战事发生前，他和我曾在四川北路1号的日本棉纱交易所代理行——古松洋行一起做过职员。他向我借款10元作为经营煤炭生意的本金。
当时他告诉我，他住在静安寺路静安公寓218室，从事为难民服务的工作。关于借款一事，我答应尽力为他筹款，他说他会在12月30日下午6点再来找我。然而到了那个时间，他并没有出现。因为我没能筹到钱给他，我决定去给他一个答复。于是我和朋友邹锦云一起去了静安寺路静安公寓218室，在那里我们被侦探带到了成都路捕房。

签名：凌联芳。

page_data.en:
Li Nyih-jing ( 李葉勤 )
Ningpo                                      D.S. Pitts
Chengtu Rd 3tn.      30/12/37               D.S.I. Kao Yen-ken

My name is Li Nyih-jing, age 21, a native of
Ningpo and single. I am unemployed but was formerly
a clerk in the Kuh Sung Firm, a Japanese cotton yarn
exchange agency, 1 Szechuen Road. I am at present living
in Room 218, Bubbling Well Apartments, Bubbling Well Road.
Following the outbreak of the local hostilities,
I went to Hangchow to take refuge and later to my native
place at Ningpo. On December 11, I returned to Shanghai
with a view to withdrawing my deposits from the Bank of
China and the Yien Nyih Bank. I withdrew $92.46, and
remitted $80 to my uncle in Ningpo, retaining the remainder
in order to open a stall in Shanghai so as to earn a living.
About December 17, I opened a macaroni stall on Wuting Road
in front of the Wu Sung Flour Shop, near Carter Road.
On December 24, as I had lost most of my money, I decided
to close the stall. At that time I lived in the Woo Sung
Flour Shop. During my stay there, one of my friends named
Tseu Zung-teh called on me often. On December 24, as the
room in the flour shop was small, Tseu advised me to stay
with him in Room 218, Bubbling Well Apartments, Bubbling
Well Road, which, he told me, was an office for the relief
of refugees. There I have stayed up to the present.
As there were many persons present in the room during
the day, I remained there only during the night.
I am not a member of the Vocational Circles National
Salvation Association nor of the Refugee Camp Workers' Lien
Nyi Society.
page_data.zh:
李葉勤
宁波                                          警官：D.S. Pitts
成都路捕房      1937年12月30日               高级探员：Kao Yen-ken

我叫李葉勤，21岁，宁波人，未婚。我目前无业，但以前曾在四川北路1号的日本棉纱交易所代理行——古松洋行担任职员。我目前住在静安寺路静安公寓218室。
本地战事爆发后，我先去杭州避难，后来回到家乡宁波。12月11日，我回到上海，打算从中国银行和仁记银行提取存款。我提取了92.46元，汇给在宁波的叔叔80元，留下余款以便在上海开个小摊谋生。
大约12月17日，我在靠近卡特路的吴淞路和生面粉店门前开了一个通心粉摊。
12月24日，由于大部分资金亏损，我决定关闭摊位。当时我住在和生面粉店。在我住在那里期间，一个叫周成德的朋友经常来看我。12月24日，因为面粉店的房间很小，周建议我和他一起住在静安寺路静安公寓218室，他告诉我那是难民救济办公室。我一直住在那里直到现在。
由于白天房间里有很多人，我只在晚上待在那里。
我不是职业界救国会的成员，也不是难民收容所工作人员联益社的成员。

page_data.en:
- 2 -

I know nothing of Tseu Zung-teh's activities or
private life beyond the fact that prior to the trouble in
Shanghai he worked in the same concern at 1 Szechuen Road
as I did.

Signed : Ling Nyih-jing.
page_data.zh:
- 2 -

除了知道周成德在上海出事之前和我在同一家位于四川北路1号的机构工作外，我对他的活动或私生活一无所知。

签名：凌尼清（音译，原文签名为 Ling Nyih-jing，对应中文名应为李葉勤，此处依原文签名拼写保留或修正为李葉勤，鉴于上文已译李葉勤，此处签名实为同一人，故译为李葉勤）。

*(注：原文签名处拼写为 Ling Nyih-jing，但根据上下文及上一页标题 Li Nyih-jing ( 李葉勤 )，此人即为李葉勤。此处忠实于原文签名栏的拼写错误，但在译文中应保持一致性，故仍译为李葉勤)*

签名：李葉勤。

page_data.en:
Oo Ching Wen (鄔錦文)
Ningpo                                      D.S. Pitts
Chengtu Rd.3tn.    Dec.30,1937.             Clerk Zung.

My name is Oo Ching Wen. I am 19 years of age, a native
of Ningpo, single, and unemployed at present. I am living
at No. 1017 Sinza Road.
Prior to the outbreak of the Sino-Japanese hostilities,
I was employed as an inspector of the Shanghai Office of
the Joss Paper Tax Bureau, No. 230 Dah Mou Deu, Nantao,
but was deprived of employment owing to the hostilities.
As I had nothing to do, I often visited my old friend Ling
Lien Faung(凌联芳), co-proprietor of the Woo Sung (和生)
Macaroni Shop, at No. 25 Wuting Road. Ling and I were
fellow workers in the Shanghai Cotton Exchange, Avenue
Edward VII, about three years ago.
At 8 p.m., December 30, I again called upon Ling Lien
Faung at No. 25 Wuting Road. He told me that he was going
to visit Tseu Zung Teh(in custody) at Room 218, Bubbling
Well Road, to ask for a loan from him. Tseu is also a
friend of mine, as we three were fellow workers in the
Shanghai Cotton Exchange, Avenue Edward VII. Consequently
Ling asked me to accompany him to Tseu's place and I
agreed. Upon entering Room 218, Bubbling Well Apartments,
both of us were arrested by the Police. I do not know
the reason of our arrest, and have no knowledge of the
activities of the two friends mentioned above.

(signed) Oo Ching Wen.
page_data.zh:
鄔錦文
宁波                                          警官：D.S. Pitts
成都路捕房    1937年12月30日                  记录员：Zung。

我叫鄔錦文。我19岁，宁波人，未婚，目前无业。我住在新闸路1017号。
在中日敌对行动爆发之前，我在南市大码头230号冥镪税局上海办事处担任稽查员，但因战事而失业。
因为无事可做，我经常拜访我的老朋友凌联芳，他是吴淞路25号和生通心粉店的共同经营者。大约三年前，我和凌在爱多亚路上海棉花交易所曾是同事。
12月30日晚上8点，我再次到吴淞路25号拜访凌联芳。他告诉我他要去静安寺路静安公寓218室看望周成德（在押），并向他借款。周也是我的朋友，因为我们三人曾在爱多亚路上海棉花交易所共事。因此，凌让我陪他去周某那里，我同意了。进入静安公寓218室后，我们两人均被警察逮捕。我不知道被捕的原因，也不了解上述两位朋友的活动情况。

（签名）鄔錦文。

page_data.en:
Loo Wen-lai （盧文瀾）
Nyi Ping （敘府, Szechuen                  D.S. McKeown
Chengtu Rd Stn.        30/12/37             Clerk Loh Wei-kong

My name is Loo Wen-lai, age 36, native of Nyi Ping,
single,
Szechuen,/residing in the Yuin Tung （運通） Steamship
Company, North Soochow Road.    My father died when I
was twelve years of age.    When I was six years old, I
commenced studying Chinese under a tutor.  I went to the
High Primary School established by the Hsien Government
at my native place, at the age of 13.  After two years,
I continued my study in the Junior Middle School, also
established by the Hsien Government at my native place.
Owing to the fact that my family was poor, I went to the
Southern Szechuen Academy at Loochow （瀘州）, Szechuen,
where the tuition was free.  I graduated from that school
at the age of 21, and then became a teacher of the Zoong
Yee Primary School （忠義小學） at Loochow.  I held this
position for half a year, after which I returned to my
native place with a view to seeking better employment,
but failed.  I remained idle at home for about ten months,
until May, 1933, when I left for Chengtu, with a view to
carrying on my study in the Szechuen University, but I
abandoned this decision because I learned that the Ming
Sung Steamship Company was in need of employees.  I passed
the examination for my employment, and was despatched in
August, 1933 to the General Office of the Company at
Chungking, at a monthly pay of $8.00.  Being dissatisfied,
I resigned after six months, and came to Shanghai in March,
1934 by a steamer of the Ming Sung Company, free of charge
(employees of the Company were entitled free passage).
page_data.zh:
盧文瀾
四川敘府                                      警官：D.S. McKeown
成都路捕房        1937年12月30日             记录员：Loh Wei-kong

我叫盧文瀾，36岁，四川敘府人，未婚，居住在苏州河北路運通轮船公司。我十二岁时父亲去世。六岁时，我开始跟随塾师学习中文。十三岁时，我进入家乡由县政府设立的高等小学读书。两年后，我继续在家乡由县政府设立的初级中学学习。由于家境贫寒，我去了四川泸州免收学费的川南师范学校。二十一岁时我从该校毕业，随后成为泸州忠義小學的教师。我担任此职半年，之后为了寻求更好的工作回到家乡，但未成功。我在家闲居了大约十个月，直到1933年5月，我前往成都，打算在四川大学继续深造，但当我得知民生轮船公司需要员工时，便放弃了这一决定。我通过了入职考试，并于1933年8月被派往该公司重庆总办事处，月薪8元。因不满意，六个月后我辞职，并于1934年3月乘坐民生公司的轮船免费（公司员工享有免费乘船权）来到上海。

page_data.en:
- 2 -

Upon arrival, I resided at the upper kitchen room, 3 Yue
Shing Li, Avenue Foch, the home of my friend Mr. Tu Tsoo-
yien (杜祖禎), who was an employee of the Chung San
Cultural Institute (中山文化教育館), Avenue Foch.
About twenty days later, in April, I left my friend for
Nanking with a view to studying in the Central Political
Academy. I remained in Nanking for about three months
during which I prepared for examination to join the
academy, and Mr. Tu remitted me $10.00 each month for
my expenses. As a failed in the examination, I returned
to Shanghai in July, and resided with Mr. Tu Tsoo-yien.
Shortly after my return to Shanghai, I participated in the
examination for joining the Mongolian and Thibetan Institute,
Junghwa. I succeeded in the examination and studied for
two years. I graduated in the summer of 1936, and became
a teacher of the Ming Tse (明志) Primary School, Meichow
Road. I held this position until the outbreak of the local
Sino-Japanese hostilities.

After the commencement of the local conflict, I
served as a teacher for juvenile refugees in the camp
established in the Empire Theatre, French Concession, under
the auspices of the Szechuen Fellow Countrymen's Association.

Shortly before the withdrawal of the Chinese troops
from Shanghai, the refugee camp was closed owing to
financial difficulty, consequently I was rendered idle.

Regarding the leaflet entitled "General Outline
of Work during the Propaganda Period," which was seized
page_data.zh:
- 2 -

抵达后，我住在朋友杜祖禎先生家的福煦路悦兴里3号楼上厨房。杜先生是福煦路中山文化教育馆的雇员。
大约二十天后，即四月份，我离开朋友前往南京，打算进入中央政治学院学习。我在南京待了大约三个月，期间准备参加学院的入学考试，杜先生每月汇给我10元作为生活费。由于考试落榜，我于七月返回上海，并与杜祖禎先生同住。
回到上海后不久，我参加了位于中华路的蒙藏研究所的入学考试。我成功通过考试并学习了两年。我于1936年夏季毕业，成为梅丘路明志小学的教师。我一直担任此职，直到本地中日敌对行动爆发。

本地冲突开始后，我在四川同乡会资助下，于法租界大戏院设立的难民营中担任青少年难民教师。

在中国军队撤离上海前不久，难民营因财政困难而关闭，因此我变得无所事事。

关于被查获的题为《宣传时期工作大纲》的传单

page_data.en:
- 3 -

from me by the Police, I have to state that it was issued
to me by one Ling Yih-sin (林一心), with whom I
became acquainted recently through the introduction of
my friend Mr. Liu Vong-yuen (刘望远), who is also a
native of Szechuan. I met Ling several times on the streets
after the removal of the hostilities from Shanghai, and
requested him to assist me in seeking employment in refugee
camps, but up to the present, he has not recommended me to
any camp. He, however, told me during one of our meetings
on the street to call upon him at 77 Tsingtao Road. I went
to see Ling at this address on or about December 22 for the
purpose of getting a reply in connection with my request
for his assistance in securing employment in camps, when he
delivered to me the leaflet without instructions.

I have not participated in any activities conducted
by local national salvation associations, except during the
progress of the local hostilities, I solicited contributions
from my fellow provincials towards the fund for the purchase
of comforts for Chinese soldiers. The contribution
soliciting movement was carried out in the name of the Jui
Tse Study Society (求智读书会) formed by members of
the refugee camp including Mr. Liu Vong-yuen and I myself,
at the request of the members of the Vocational Circles'
National Salvation Association during their visit at our
refugee camp to console refugees. Approximately $80.00
were raised and delivered to the Association in question.

I am not a member of the Communist Party, nor a Kuomintang
member.
Signed : Loo Wen-lai.
page_data.zh:
- 3 -

被警方从我处搜走，我必须声明，该传单是由林一心（Ling Yih-sin）发给我的。我最近通过同为四川籍的朋友刘望远（Liu Vong-yuen）先生的介绍而结识了他。在上海战事平息后，我曾在街上多次遇见林，并请求他协助我在难民收容所寻找工作，但截至目前，他并未将我推荐至任何收容所。然而，他在我们的一次街头会面中告诉我，让我去青岛路77号找他。大约在12月22日，我前往该地址见林，目的是就他协助我在收容所就业一事寻求答复，当时他将这份传单交给了我，未附任何指示。

除在当地战事进行期间外，我未曾参与任何地方救国会开展的活动。在此期间，我曾向同乡募集捐款，用于购买慰问品赠予中国士兵。此次募捐活动是以“求智读书会”的名义进行的，该会由包括刘望远先生和我本人在内的难民收容所成员组成。此举是应职业界救国会成员在访问我们难民收容所慰问难民时提出的要求而进行的。共筹集约80元，并已交付给该会。

我既不是共产党党员，也不是国民党党员。
签名：罗文来（Loo Wen-lai）。

page_data.en:
King Jing ( 金 瑩 )
Anhwel                                     D.S. McKeown
Chengtu Rd Stn.        30/12/37            D.S.I. Kao Yen-ken

My name is King Jing, female, aged 23, a native of
Anhwel and single. I am a student of the Great China
University. Following the outbreak of the local
hostilities, I removed from the school to the residence
of my school mate named Miss Wu Bai-hwa ( 吳佩華 ),
54 (?) Route Dolfus. About a month ago, Miss Wu went to
Hankow, and I therefore went to live with a friend of
Miss Wu, named Ho Ying ( 何 英 ), in the room above the
kitchen at 77 Tsingtao Road.

During my stay in that house, I noticed that a
number of persons visited the kitchen occupied by one
Chu ( 朱 ) and that from conversations among themselves
I realized that they were national salvation workers.
I and Ho Ying one day talked about them. I was of the
opinion that should the police take action against the
occupants of the kitchen, the authorities might suspect us,
I being a student, to be connected with them. Therefore we
agreed that we should claim to be relatives. This is why
we claimed to be relatives when we were taken into the
police station.

Regarding Ling Yih-sing ( 林一心 ), Ling was one
of the visitors of Tsu. I saw Ling about two or three
times. He wears spectacles, is of medium size, wears
foreign dress, and speaks Szechuen dialect. I did not see
him bring or take any books. I observed him talking
with Tsu.

I do not know to whom the male clothing, etc.,
page_data.zh:
金莹（King Jing）
安徽                                     D.S. McKeown
成都路捕房        1937年12月30日            D.S.I. 高恩肯（Kao Yen-ken）

我叫金莹，女，23岁，安徽人，未婚。我是大夏大学的学生。当地战事爆发后，我从学校搬至我的同学吴佩华（Wu Bai-hwa）小姐的住处，地址为多尔富斯路（Route Dolfus）54号（?）。大约一个月前，吴小姐前往汉口，因此我搬去与吴小姐的一位朋友何英（Ho Ying）同住，住在青岛路77号厨房上方的房间里。

在我居住在那栋房子期间，我注意到有许多人拜访由一名姓朱（Tsu）的人占用的厨房，并且从他们之间的谈话中，我意识到他们是救国工作者。有一天，我和何英谈论起这些人。我认为，如果警方对厨房的居住者采取行动，当局可能会怀疑身为学生的我与他们有关联。因此，我们商定声称彼此是亲戚。这就是为什么我们在被带进警察局时声称是亲戚的原因。

关于林一心（Ling Yih-sing），林是朱的访客之一。我见过林两三次。他戴眼镜，中等身材，穿西装，说四川方言。我没看见他携带或拿走任何书籍。我观察到他在与朱交谈。

我不知道在我房间里发现的男装等物品

page_data.en:
- 2 -
which was found in my room belongs, but I think it is the
property of a former tenant who has left for **〔此处转录不清〕**.
I am not a member of any national salvation
society.

Signed : King Jing.
page_data.zh:
- 2 -
属于谁，但我认为那是已前往**〔此处转录不清〕**的前任租客的财产。
我不是任何救国团体的成员。

签名：金莹（King Jing）。

page_data.en:
Ho Ping (何平) alias Ho Ying (何英).
Hankow                                                                                       ... McKeown
Chengtu Rd Stn. 31/12/1937                                                       T.I.I. Kao Yen-ken.

My name is Ho Ping alias Ho Ying, aged 56, a native
of Hankow and married. I am a school teacher by profession,
being a teacher in the Yangtzepoo Social Centre Primary
School, Yangtzepoo Road, prior to the hostilities. I
am living in 77 Tsingtao Road.

I am now serving in the Women's Class of the 7th
Ningpo Fellow Countrymen's Association, Tsingtao Road, near
Avenue Road. This place is opened by an "Education 普及教育服務團
Developing Service Group", which was formed following the
out break of hostilities and aimed at national salvation
work. The Group, with an office at 77 Tsingtao Road, was
declared dissolved when the Chinese troops withdrew from the
Shanghai area. It, however, continued to function
secretly at the same address. At first I was paid $10
per month without lodging, but at present I am paid $6
with free lodging at 77 Tsingtao Road. I am paid by Ling
Ih-sing (林一心), one of the leading members of the Group.
There are about 40 workers operating in about 20 classes
known as "Children's classes" or "Women's classes".

Tsu Chih-tung (朱澤東), a male youth of about 20,
is the man watching the place and receiving letters and
messages.

Ling Ih-sing visits the place, 77 Tsingtao Road, from
time to time. His whereabouts is not known.

In the women's class I am teaching, I was instructed
to teach things in connection with the national salvation
before the withdrawal of the Chinese troops, but after the
page_data.zh:
何平（Ho Ping），又名何英（Ho Ying）。
汉口                                                                                       ... McKeown
成都路捕房 1937年12月31日                                                       T.I.I. 高恩肯（Kao Yen-ken）。

我叫何平，又名何英，56岁，汉口市人，已婚。我的职业是学校教师，战事前在杨树浦社会中心初级小学（Yangtzepoo Social Centre Primary School，位于杨树浦路）任教。我现居住在青岛路77号。

我目前在青岛路近爱文义路（Avenue Road）处的宁波同乡会第七分会妇女班任职。该处由一个“普及教育服务团”开办，该团是在战事爆发后成立的，旨在从事救国工作。该团在青岛路77号设有办事处，在中国军队撤离上海地区时被宣布解散。然而，它在同一地址继续秘密运作。起初我月薪10元，不包住宿，但目前我月薪6元，并在青岛路77号免费住宿。我的薪水由该团主要成员之一林一心（Ling Ih-sing）支付。大约有40名工作人员在约20个被称为“儿童班”或“妇女班”的班级中工作。

朱泽东（Tsu Chih-tung），一名约20岁的青年男子，是负责看守该处并接收信件和消息的人。

林一心不时访问青岛路77号这一地点。他的行踪不明。

在我任教的妇女班中，在中国军队撤离之前，我被指示教授与救国相关的内容，但在

page_data.en:
- 2 -

withdrawal in view of the local tense situation, I abandoned
all political activities and devoted myself to pure
education.

There was a mimeograph machine on the premises.
I remember that some class teachers made use of it to print
coloured New Year greeting cards, the contents of which I
have not seen nor do I know.

In celebration of the New Year, I only asked
the students, numbering 30, to contribute towards the relief
of refugees and would like to instruct some students to
dance in refugee camps as entertainment on January 1.
I do not use greeting cards.

I am not a Communist.

(signed) Ho Ping alias Ho Ying.
page_data.zh:
- 2 -

撤离后，鉴于当地局势紧张，我放弃了所有政治活动，致力于纯粹的教育工作。

该处有一台油印机。我记得有些班级老师利用它印制彩色新年贺卡，但我未曾看过其内容，也不知晓具体内容。

为庆祝新年，我只要求30名学生为救济难民捐款，并打算指导一些学生在1月1日到难民收容所表演舞蹈作为娱乐。我不使用贺卡。

我不是共产党员。

（签名）何平，又名何英。

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
S.1, Special Branch
REPORT

**（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE / File No. REGISTRY / No. S. B. D. 7064 / 7 November 35）**
Date ____ November 7, 35

Subject Leader of the "Walking Propaganda Group of Chinese Citizens to
Accelerate national Salvation by Aviation" returns to Shanghai.

Made by D.P.S. Mackay Forwarded by **〔此处为手写签名〕**

Chen Tseng Loong (陳正龍), leader of the "Walking
Propaganda Group of Chinese Citizens to Accelerate national
Salvation by Aviation," who left Shanghai in August last year
for Chekiang, Anhwei, Kiangse and other places, returned to
Shanghai from Fokien on November 4. On the afternoon of
November 5, he left for Nanking, where he will remain for
a fortnight, to obtain the approval of the authorities to his
proposal to carry out propaganda work in the South Sea islands.

The aim of this Walking Propaganda Group is to arouse
the interest of the Chinese people in aviation, and to induce
them to subscribe to the purchase of an aeroplane, which will
be donated to the Government.

When Chen Tseng Loong commenced his tour last year,
he was accompanied by 13 members of the Group. During the
course of the expedition, six members withdrew, three died
on the way from Kiangse to Fokien and the remaining four were
forced to abandon the party in Fokien owing to lack of funds.

The above information was obtained by Agent 39.

**〔此处为手写签名〕**
D. P. S.

D. C. (Special Branch).

上海公共租界工部局警务处
S.1，特别分部
报告

**（印：上海公共租界工部局警务处 / 档案号 REGISTRY / 编号 S. B. D. 7064 / 1935年11月7日）**
日期 ____ 1935年11月7日

主题：“中国公民步行宣传团以航空加速救国”团长返回上海。

由副警务总监麦凯（D.P.S. Mackay）呈报 转呈 **〔此处为手写签名〕**

“中国公民步行宣传团以航空加速救国”团长陈正龙（Chen Tseng Loong），于去年八月离开上海前往浙江、安徽、江西等地，于11月4日从福建返回上海。11月5日下午，他前往南京，将在那里停留两周，以争取当局批准其在南洋群岛开展宣传工作的提议。

该步行宣传团的目的是唤起中国人民对航空的兴趣，并诱导他们捐款购买一架飞机，捐赠给政府。

去年陈正龙开始巡回宣传时，有13名团员陪同。在远征过程中，六名成员退出，三名在从江西到福建的途中死亡，其余四名因缺乏资金被迫在福建离队。

以上信息由39号探员获取。

**〔此处为手写签名〕**
副警务总监（D. P. S.）

助理总监（特别分部）（D. C. (Special Branch)）。
